reviews.author: Mạch Khang
reviews.text:
Our stay at Paradisus Cancun was absolutely wonderful from beginning to end. This resort exceeded our expectations in every way, and honestly, we can’t think of a single thing to complain about.

The front desk team was amazing and made us feel welcome from the moment we arrived. Even though the official check-in time was 3:00 PM, they kindly accommodated us and allowed us to check in early at noon, which made a huge difference after traveling.

Our room was always spotless thanks to the incredible housekeeping team. The room service and housekeeping staff were professional, helpful, and paid great attention to detail. It was always a pleasure returning to a clean, comfortable room.

A special thank you to Maylin and Esmeralda from the Kids Activities team. They were fantastic with the children, full of energy, kindness, and patience. They truly helped make our family’s vacation even more memorable.

The staff throughout the resort, especially in the restaurants, were consistently friendly and welcoming. Everyone always had a smile on their face and genuinely seemed happy to help. The team members greeting guests at the entrance of the resort were also exceptional and made us feel valued every day.

What really stands out about Paradisus Cancun is its people. The beautiful property and beach are wonderful, but it’s the hardworking employees who create such a special experience. They work incredibly hard and deserve recognition for everything they do.

We had an amazing vacation and created memories that will last a lifetime. If you’re planning a stay here, one piece of advice: bring some small cash for tips. The resort staff truly deserve it for the outstanding service they provide.

Thank you, Paradisus Cancun, for such a fantastic stay. We can’t wait to come back! ❤️🌴☀️

However, I'll comment on the unpleasant experience we had at check-in: I was literally called a liar by a poorly informed employee regarding a benefit I have as a member of the Melia Rewards club. They didn't listen to me when I arrived to discuss my request, they made light of my needs, and on top of that, I was considered a liar. In addition, the room service is not what it used to be; they leave things unreplenished, don't clean properly, etc., and this is because the hotel's capacity is at 30/40%. Another important point is that they offer you dishes in restaurants that are not included in the purchased package and they don't explain this to you, then after eating comes the surprise with the card machine! reviews.text:
Our stay at Paradisus Cancún exceeded every expectation.

From the moment we arrived, we were treated with warmth, professionalism, and genuine hospitality. The resort itself is beautiful, well maintained, and offers an outstanding experience, but what truly sets it apart is the people.

A special thank you to Alejandro and Rommel from the Family Concierge team. They were phenomenal throughout our stay. They anticipated needs before we even had to ask, provided excellent recommendations, and always made us feel like valued guests. Their attention to detail and commitment to exceptional service made a lasting impression on our family.

The restaurants, pool staff, housekeeping team, bartenders, and servers were all wonderful. Every interaction was positive, and it was clear how much pride the staff takes in creating a memorable experience for guests.

One idea I would encourage the resort to consider is providing a QR code tipping option for staff members. We quickly learned that cash goes fast when so many people are providing exceptional service. There were several team members we wanted to recognize and thank, but we simply ran out of cash during our stay. A digital tipping option would be convenient for guests and would help ensure outstanding employees receive the appreciation they deserve.

This trip was a special graduation celebration, and Paradisus Cancún helped make it unforgettable. Thank you to everyone who contributed to such an amazing experience. We will be recommending this resort to family and friends and hope to return again.

reviews.text:
My husband and I celebrated our 20-year anniversary at Paradisus Cancun in April 2026, and we had a wonderful experience.

The resort had recently reopened after renovations, and everything felt fresh, modern, and very clean. The beach was beautiful, the pools were relaxing, and the grounds were well maintained.

The highlight of our stay was the staff. Everyone was friendly, helpful, and genuinely seemed to care about making our vacation special. A special thank you to Chris, our Reserve Concierge, who went above and beyond throughout our stay.

If you’re considering upgrading to The Reserve Adults Only section, I highly recommend it. The concierge service, exclusive lounge, premium drinks, coffee bar, adults-only dining, and Bali beds were well worth it.

The resort offers several dining options, including steak, seafood, Japanese cuisine, and a buffet. While the food wasn’t our favorite part of the trip, breakfast was excellent and there was plenty of variety.

We especially enjoyed the live saxophone music during breakfast, the beautiful beach, and the peaceful gym each morning.

Overall, we had an amazing anniversary trip and would gladly return to Paradisus Cancun in the future.

reviews.author: Maryium Tariq
reviews.text:
Our recent stay at this all-inclusive resort was a mix of positives and frustrations. The biggest highlight was definitely the cleanliness and recent renovations throughout the property. The resort is beautifully updated, modern, and very clean, and the rooms themselves were visually impressive.

Unfortunately, our experience with the accommodations quickly became stressful. Before arrival, we requested that both parties in our group be placed near each other on the same floor. While we were technically on the same floor, our rooms ended up being on opposite sides of the building. After unpacking, we were asked to move rooms entirely. The second room we were given had a faulty air conditioning system, and despite reporting the issue multiple times over the course of three days, nobody came to properly address it. After escalating the situation to upper management on the third night, we were moved yet again to another room. At that point, we were upgraded to an ocean-view room, which was appreciated, but we only had two nights remaining in our stay. Although the rooms themselves were beautiful, constantly relocating made the overall experience frustrating and exhausting.

Another disappointment was the food and dining experience. For a resort marketed as family-friendly, dining options during the daytime were extremely limited. Between noon and 5 PM, only a small number of buffet-style options were available, while the other restaurants did not open until the evening. Although the food presentation looked appealing, most meals lacked flavor and felt underwhelming overall. Room service was available, but the menu was extremely limited, and delivery times were close to two hours.

The children’s indoor play area also had very restricted hours. In many cases, the only way to access the service during the day was to leave children unattended with their staff, which we personally were not comfortable with. Additionally, the advertised “$200 resort credit” was misleading. The credit is broken into small portions that can only be applied toward select services, making it difficult to actually use in a meaningful way. We ended up not using it at all.

One of the main reasons we booked this resort was for the beach. However, during our visit in April 2026, the beach was heavily affected by seaweed. We understand this can be seasonal, but the beach experience looked very different from the photos advertised online and on social media. We also found it disappointing that the beach cabanas were reserved exclusively for premium/reserve guests, and we were not allowed to apply our resort credits toward using them.

Overall, this resort is beautiful aesthetically, and the renovations are very well done. However, the service, food quality, and family-friendly amenities did not meet expectations. As this was our first all-inclusive experience, it unfortunately left us feeling disappointed. While the resort has potential, there are still many operational issues that need improvement. If you are traveling with family, I would personally recommend choosing a more established resort with stronger daytime activities, better food quality, and more consistent customer service.

Lastly, there was some operational issues with the restaurant, my son’s favourite part was the ice cream shop, and for the last two days it was closed because there were some issues with the fridge.

Without a doubt, employees like them elevate any business and are a fundamental part of its success and prestige. Congratulations to both of them and to the company for having such valuable members of their team.

reviews.text:
Our stay at Paradisus Cancun was incredible, and a large part of that wonderful experience was thanks to Fernanda Trejo, our concierge.

From the very first moment, Fernanda was incredibly kind, professional, and always attentive to our needs. She made sure we had everything we needed to fully enjoy our stay. She always attended to us with a great attitude, a smile, and a tremendous willingness to help.

Something we really want to highlight is that she went far beyond our expectations. I asked her for help finding cosmetic treatments in Cancun, and she recommended one of the best specialists. She also recommended shopping spots and other places that turned out to be the best options.

Fernanda truly made us feel well taken care of, valued, and welcome. Her dedication, attention to detail, and excellent service made our experience even more special.

We recommend her 10000%. Paradisus Cancun is incredibly lucky to have such a dedicated, kind, and professional person on their team.
Just like everyone else who works at Paradisus, they were the best.

Thank you for everything, Fernanda! You made our stay so much more special.

reviews.author: Emma Ruddick-Ferrat
reviews.text:
Omar, our Butler, was nothing short of fantastic. We came during a shoulder season and would highly recommend. Omar helped us make dinner reservations each night as well as organize Bali beds by the pool. There was some seaweed on the beach but the pool amenities and Bali bed certainly made up for it. Omar was very attentive on WhatsApp and was able to meet our requests. Like having the room clean, cold water, and AC on after a beach excursions off site. Omar also organized some birthday surprises in the room for our room and friend’s room including a gluten free cake for our celiac friend. He was attentive to our various dietary restrictions and would make sure restaurants were aware and had suitable options for us. Omar is kind, attentive, and hardworking. We love him and highly recommend him. The Reserve upgrade was well and truly worth it.

Carlos at Sal was a great server. Attentive to our dietary restrictions one celiac and a vegetarian. He explained how the menu worked. And even helped with a special birthday treat for two people in our group. Thank you for a lovely dinner and experience! Worth the Reserve upgrade. To enjoy the experience.

reviews.author: Lou Dempsey

Omar our butler was beyond amazing, made our stay absolutely magical, always attentive and went beyond with everything for us. It’s a 10/10 from accommodation, ease of day bed use, ability to reserve speciality restaurants, amenities cleanliness/comfort of the rooms. At no point did we go hungry or thirsty, fantastic food options for celiacs (staff well aware), so much fresh fruit and delicious options. Amazing greenery/plants everywhere, gorgeous tropical vibes throughout the hotel.
We cannot wait to return here again.

Our stay at Paradisus Cancun was absolutely unforgettable! From the moment we arrived, the entire hotel staff made us feel welcomed, cared for, and truly on vacation. But the real highlight of our trip was our amazing butler, Erick Mejenes! He went above and beyond every single day to make sure our family had the best experience possible. His attention to detail, kindness, professionalism, and genuine care made us feel so special. No request was ever too much, and he always made everything smooth and stress-free for us.

Erick truly elevated our entire vacation experience and is honestly one of the best butlers we’ve ever had. Paradisus Cancun is lucky to have someone like him representing their resort!

Thank you again to Erick and the entire Paradisus Cancun team for making our trip so memorable. We can’t wait to come back!

reviews.author: Diyora Khasanova
reviews.text:
From the moment we arrived, the hotel made our family feel welcomed and well taken care of. The level of service throughout our stay was exceptional and truly made this trip special for us.

First and foremost — the family concierge service. We were lucky to have Erick Mejenes, who truly elevated our entire stay. He was always available, answered all of our questions, booked restaurants and spa appointments, and helped organize family events like birthdays. His attention to detail and genuine care made everything feel smooth and stress-free.

Second, if you’re traveling with kids, you should definitely choose this hotel for its amazing kids program. Our stay wouldn’t have been the same without the extra care and attention from the wonderful Kidsdom team — especially Maylin, Fernanda, Esmeralda, Alondra, and Vianey. Our son is usually very shy, but he couldn’t wait to go to Kidsdom every day. The program was very well organized and engaging.

Among the extra activities offered by the hotel, we especially enjoyed the Cocoa Ceremony and the cocktail master class, hosted by attentive staff members including Mauricio, Daniel, and bartender Xavier.

Among the à la carte restaurants, I’d highly recommend Kao, Blue Agave (especially the caramel flan ice cream dessert), and Vibra, where we received especially high-end service from a very attentive waiter named Omar.

reviews.text:
Once again, another memorable trip and stay at Paradisus Cancun. First time back since renovation reopening and as always, it was a magical stay!
We stay on the Reserve side and were excited to see the updates throughout the resort but more importantly were excited to see the staff that came back. Our amazing experience is curated by so many of the staff that are always so lovely, they are professional, attentive and caring. Diego, a supervisor there, is hands down one of the nicest people on Earth. Diego is beyond caring and very professional, took care of any of our needs. Diego is the best! The staff at Sante/Reserve Pool, from pre-renovation staff to new employees are all super special and great people to us that show so much care and love. The staff that we know for years need major shout outs, Cesar, Julio, Yamil, Javier, David, and Victor. Everytime we go they treat us with so much care. This time around we met new staff that are cut from the same cloth, professional, sweet, vibrant and attentive. Shout out to Cynthia, Gemma, Valeria, and the new pool staff Mikele. Our concierge Galdino is so awesome, he is knowledgeable of the resort and surrounding areas, he takes care of our every need, he is available to us at all times, he definitely made our stay so much easier and relaxing.
The resort is amazing and beautiful, but the thing that keeps us coming back is the amazing staff.
The special activities/entertainment staff all came on board with the reopening but they fall right into place, as if they have worked there for years. They are very charismatic, fun and entertaining. Jesus, Uriel, and the rest of the staff, definitely set the tone during activities and classes to get everyone involved and have fun. They are awesome!
One of the major changes that happened was that our beloved Nespresso bar moved from being the center point when you enter from the beach/pool side, to having its own location on the same floor a few feet away. While we are bias and loved how the Nespresso bar was the first thing you saw when entering Tower 3 illuminated and cheerful, we do also enjoy that it has its own location along with the addition of the ice cream parlor. Along with the location of rhe old Nespresso bar being right in the middle with the smell of coffee and illuminating the walkway, Alejandro, the barista there is what made every morning with his infectious personality and loving demeanor. Alejandro is amazing and he is surrounded by nee staff that are just as approachable and nice, showing that they enjoy what they do, Norma, Rosalinda, Karina, Perla, all amazing!

reviews.author: Yolanda Del Angel
reviews.text:
Excellent, recently renovated hotel. The warm hospitality of the staff is truly remarkable. From the moment we arrived, Joshua gave us an upgrade in honor of our anniversary. Alan, Marco, and Amelia at the front desk were incredibly kind.

Our concierge, Carlos, was super attentive to all our needs from beginning to end, making our stay truly special!

Víctor, the concierge in the Reserve pool area, was attentive and friendly at all times—super helpful.

Uriel in the entertainment department was very friendly and had an excellent attitude.

The dinners at Capella restaurant were delicious, and we received excellent service from Jorge and Captain Antonio.

At Blue Agave restaurant, the tacos were exquisite (I highly recommend the lengua and gringa tacos). Mohazir and Xóchitl provided wonderful service.

Sal restaurant was EXQUISITE! Everything was delicious from start to finish. We received excellent service from Carlos, the manager Daniel, and the hostess Paola. Carlos was kind enough to treat us to a cake for our anniversary.

At Agua Marina restaurant, Moisés and Yessenia provided excellent service and also gave us a small cake for our anniversary.

At Kao restaurant, everything was delicious, and Arce provided excellent service.

Because we upgraded to a Reserve room, we received a complimentary Sunset Cruise. Daladier was incredibly helpful and attentive throughout our stay. Uriel from the entertainment team got everyone dancing.

Guillermo Pérez from the spa area was very friendly, and Carlos was always attentive.

At The Reserve pool area, Arnulfo was incredibly kind and attentive. Vianney was also very friendly at the family pool area.

At Santé restaurant, everything was delicious! And Cynthia and Javier provided excellent service.

Juan Carlos and Omar, promoters of the Circle program, approached us in a very friendly manner to offer us more information. We'll get in touch with them to arrange another visit to the hotel and learn more about it, as it's a wonderful hotel!

It's definitely a hotel we recommend for its excellent facilities and the quality of its food and drinks. But above all, the service we received from the staff was unparalleled!

reviews.author: noemi juarez
reviews.text:
Arce and Daniel gave us spectacular service; the Japanese restaurant was delicious and highly recommended.
They gave us excellent recommendations for trying something different and exquisite.
Thank you so much!
We would definitely dine here again!

reviews.author: David Butcher
reviews.text: Great spot. Had a great dinner at the Japanese restaurant with our server Gustavo. All the service was great

reviews.author: Francisco
reviews.text: First-class service! Edgar treated us wonderfully at the Capela restaurant ♥️👌

reviews.author: Cojamin
reviews.text: This resort is absolutely stunning. I understand why they call themselves The Icon. The property is so grand and luxurious and in great location. We had the pleasure of staying at Paradisus Cancún in the second week of May for our anniversary. Our concierge Javier (Javo) was professional and friendly and took excellent care of us. He arranged dinner reservations, secured pool-side day beds and recommended activities daily. The service from ALL the staff was top notch. Our room at The Reserve exceeded our expectations and the view was perfect. We were sad to leave but will be back! Thank you!

reviews.author: Breanne Palmer
reviews.text:
I can’t say enough good things! We absolutely love this resort! I think we’ve found the place that we will come back to year after year.

We originally booked our trip at another resort, and after one terrible day we switched over to Paradisus.

From the moment we arrived, we have been treated so incredibly! The staff here are so friendly and amazing.

Our room is absolutely gorgeous! Looks like it’s out of a magazine.  And so clean.  The first time our room was cleaned, we came back to the cutest robes and slippers laid out for the boys!

The buffet has a lot of variety, and the food is really good!

Alondra and Maylin have such fun kids activities. So far we’ve had a foam pool party and a Mario kart balloon popping race, and my kids have loved every second!

We’re so happy we found this gorgeous resort! Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Camila López
reviews.text: 100/10 for everything! Luis Amisaday's service is highly recommended, incredible attention, a wonderful person, and the food is truly delicious! Highly recommended! 😍🫶🫶

reviews.author: Jesus Agosto
reviews.text: I had an excellent vacation at this great hotel. The room had a magnificent view, the beach was beautiful, and the facilities were very good. My family and I had a wonderful time. The food was really good, but what surprised me most was the outstanding service from our butler, Jair Canche. He's a wonderful person who greeted us with a big smile from the moment we arrived at the hotel and provided excellent service, always attentive to our needs. We are very grateful for the wonderful experience we had, and I hope to have the pleasure of meeting him again on future stays. 🙏🙏🙏

reviews.author: Benjamin Bodenschatz
reviews.text: We had an amazing stay! In particular Xavier (our concierge) has been outstanding. He was very attentive, helpful and very kind. The resort is excellent after the remodel. One item I was concerned about before arriving was the A/C based on previous reviews. But in the rooms the temperature went down to 68 degrees Fahrenheit. So nice and cool for sleeping. All restaurants were great, with the exception of Capello. The food was not terrible but also not great. Sal steakhouse was amazing and our server Carlos was great. I would highly recommend the Reserve upgrade. It’s really worth it and has a lot of cool stuff included, like the hydro spa, sunset cruise, and of course the exclusive pool area with Bali beds was awesome! We’ll definitely be back.

reviews.author: Mayelin Pena Morales
reviews.text: All the activities were incredible: painting your bag with Jesus, painting your alebrije with Giovani, boot camp with Uriel, and exercising in the pool with Mauricio. A very dynamic entertainment team.

reviews.author: Shruti Jajodia
reviews.text:
I went with my family and it was our first time in paradisus as well as in Cancun. The hotel is good with good views and lot of places to relax in. The concierge is very helpful. I would like to name Liza for helping us a lot. But the tour operator that they have, Otium tours, is really bad. They have half information with respect to tours. We took the Chichen classic with valladolid as a place to visit. But after boarding the bus, we got to know that Valladolid is not included. Upon asking to compensate, they are making all kind of excuses not to compensate it. Mr  Mauricio from Otium tours has been very rude with us. We are extremely unhappy with this service by Otium.

The thing we loved the most was their restaurants who customised food as per our requirement. We being vegetarians, Kao restaurant provided us with one of the delicious dinner with wontons, noodles, sushi, pizza and dumplings. Marco - the chef, Teresita and Ardiana for their out of the way service. Also Gastro Hall did give us a good service.

The room service was a late back. Had to call three to four times just to get water bottles and coffee mate.. yet they did not provide with the coffee mate.

Overall, had a good experience in the hotel.

reviews.text: Alberto at Kanna's Beach Club offers excellent service and recommendations. I spent the afternoon there, and everyone was very friendly. When you enter the Paradisus, you should mention that you're going to the Beach Club so they can contact Chico, who provides all the information. There are restrooms/changing rooms, showers, towels, and you can use the pool. The closest beach bed to the hotel cost 1.8k. Everyone was very friendly and helpful. I hope to return soon.

reviews.text: Uriel was the best!! The aqua tonic’s and aqua Zumba was a blast. He brought the energy got the pool fired up and made sure the guests were having a great time!! Can’t say enough good things about Uriel !!!

reviews.author: Michael Celado
reviews.text:
We are on day 1 of our stay and so far the staff has exceeded all expectations, so this review is on Customer Service only (so far):

When we arrived, we were greeted at the entrance (I believe his name was Roberto) and they helped us out of our van and with tagging our luggage. Roberto also helped our 4 year old daughter out of the van, which was sweet (especially because she can be very shy, but she still took Roberto's hand to exit the van).

They had cold towels and non-alcoholic drinks ready for myself, my wife, and two kids before we even made it into the building. Very refreshing.

Eduardo, our Family Concierge butler, introduced himself during our check-in process, and was friendly and understanding regarding our luggage, kids, and long travel day. He showed us to our room, had our dinner reservation all set for us to enjoy later, and he checked in on our table during dinner.

We had dinner at Kao, and Mario, our server went above and beyond for our family. Our daughter is a picky eater (Mac & Cheese, bread, cereal, etc.) and would not eat anything on the menu. I mentioned this to Mario, and asked if there was any way to get a bowl of plain/buttery pasta brought over for her instead. Mario said he would check on that for us (without promises) and came back a few minutes later with a heaping bowl of penne pasta, which my daughter enjoyed very much (and finished completely). Compliments to the chef for accomodating us, a big thank you to Mario at Kao for helping make my kid happy during dinner time, and much appreciation for the rest of the Paradisus staff we've met just on day 1.

DAY 2

We had breakfast at Vibra (I believe breakfast at Vibra is for Family Concierge only) near the kids' Aquazone area (FYI, there are mosquitos here). Julio was our server and was friendly and attentive. He checked on us regularly and ensured we had all we needed.

Our server (both nights) was named Jesus. He was literally Jesus Christ bringing us food on a silver platter. Jesus was Super friendly and super nice to all of us and very patient with all of the food we ordered (which was ALOT) and never complained once after we re-ordered meals that were not even on the menu.

I would HIGHLY recommend eating at Kao everyday and asking for Jesus.

He was always looking out for us, with a super professional and friendly attitude, helping us at every turn and making our stay much more special and comfortable. reviews.author: Kristina Kamber
reviews.text:
Recently returned from a 5 day stay at the Paradisus Cancun. Upon arriving, we were checked in by Omar who was fast, efficient and very friendly, and greeted with a nice cold signature beverage.

The rooms are great, extremely clean and no issues with any amenities in the room. The beds were comfortable and everything met my expectations.

The grounds are extremely well maintained, from the lobby to the bars to the hallways, the staff were constantly cleaning to ensure a well manicured and clean resort.

We mostly stayed at the kiddie pool, it was warm and clean and  I think a good size for kids 8 and under . During our 5 day stay, there was one activity that my kids participated in and enjoyed. There was always ample seating.

The first day we arrived, we got to the pool snack bar closer to closing time so they didn’t have all the normal options available, we opted for fries and wings and pizza and it did the trick. The main buffet was less desirable the first night we arrived, the foods lacked flavoured ( not what you expect from Mexican cuisine) and it felt like there were more sides vs mains. The buffet later redeemed itself throughout the week with a great variety of fresh foods

I love that no reservations were needed for the al la carte, we tried th Mexican, the Mediterranean and Italian and had a great experience at all of them.

From the poolside staff to the waitstaff, everyone was great. I’m glad we went when it was a little on the quiet side to funny enjoy this resort.

While we didn’t go to the beach , there was very little seaweed and always palapa and beds available.

Overall great resort and look forward to returning

reviews.author: Michelle Llanes
reviews.text:
My husband and I stayed Friday through Tuesday. We were in room 5006, which was the ground floor on the Adults Only Reserve side. We had a view of the ocean and were steps away from walking outside to the pool area. Our room was large with a king size bed, sofa, table/chairs, walk-in shower, soaker tub, and outdoor patio area equipped with double lounger bed and a table and chairs. The room was clean and comfortable. Our butler, Isle, was wonderful and we utilized WhatsApp to communicate with her. All staff, waiters, bartenders, concierge, we encountered were extremely nice, patient, and kind. We had the perfect weather and ate dinner at the reservation only restaurants each evening (Sal Steakhouse, Cappella Italian & Blue Agave). Only three issues occurred and two were addressed and corrected immediately: the faucet on the tub was not connected correctly and shot off when we turned on the water; maintenance had the issue resolved quickly: at the adults only pool, a guest decided to blare their music on a portable speaker which definitely took away from the calm and peaceful vibes this area markets and we had experienced the day before; we spoke discreetly with the pool manager and the person was asked to turn down their music; the person obliged and we were back to listening to the tranquil ocean waves again. The 3rd issue was on our last morning, we had planned to sleep in and enjoy a late brunch before checking out; well the lawn maintenance staff started with their weed-eater at 7:45 am! And it did not stop for more than an hour. That, was really our only complaint with our stay. Our goal was to soak in the sun, enjoy the beautiful ocean, and relax and we accomplished that 1000%.

Xochilt at Blue Agave was an amazing server today. Service was prompt. She was attentive to our requests, and she was just a very nice person. The food was delicious too!

Roger was fantastic at Sal Steakhouse. Very attentive, informative and patient with us. And he just has a very charismatic personality. The picana and salmon were our favorites!

My husband surprised me this past week by taking me to Paradisus Cancun, where we celebrated our honeymoon. I arrived and was speechless because upon entering, you see those five pyramid-like structures, and it's truly unique. Then, in the lobby, surrounded by lush greenery… I was in love. The check-in staff were incredibly kind, and the place smelled amazing. We stayed in The Reserve (adults only). Our concierge was Sergio, an excellent gentleman—very kind, attentive, cordial, and respectful. One of the things that made the experience so wonderful was Sergio. The restaurants were delicious, and I found Kao to be beautiful, a unique and special space. I was disappointed that I couldn't try the dumplings; they weren't available. The Mexican restaurant was absolutely delicious, and I loved the service, especially since I have allergies, and they took great care of me. The steakhouse was good, although we would have appreciated more attention. They have an ice cream shop, which is super nice. The ocean view is beautiful. For families with children, there's plenty of entertainment for them. The spa staff were very friendly and helpful.

It was a special stay that I hope to repeat, and when I return, I hope Sergio is still working so he can take care of us again. I highly recommend it!

reviews.author: Ancsa Szepesi
reviews.text:
We recently stayed for 12 nights and overall had a good experience, made memorable by several outstanding staff members.
A special mention goes to Jesus, the wellness instructor, who truly elevated our stay. His yoga and meditation sessions were excellent, and we also really enjoyed his Mexican herbs class, as well as the margarita and tequila tastings; such a great mix of relaxation and culture. We had a great experience on the Sound healing as well with the team, Jesus, Giovani, Uriel, Rogelio and Mauricio.
The mixology class was another highlight, thanks to Daniel, Andres, and Giovani, who made it both fun and engaging.
We also want to recognize Jesus at KAO restaurant for his very good service, and Jesus at Zesty, who was so attentive and welcoming.

A big thank you to Sergio, our personal concierge, who was always available whenever we needed anything, his support made everything smooth and stress-free.

Uriel from the entertainment team and Sommelier Miguel was fantastic as well, they joined us during the Wine & Canvas activity, which we really enjoyed.

Daniel from the entertainment team was another staff member who stood out, always greeting us warmly and taking the time to chat whenever we crossed paths.

Also thank you David for your kind service and the Bali beds with beautiful views, I can't recall the names of your colleagues but they were great too!

One area for improvement would be the breakfast service at Sante. It was inconsistent, on some mornings it was attentive, but on others it felt disorganized. There were instances where we were seated before other guests, yet they were served drinks and coffee well before us, while we were still waiting for something as a greeting from a server. That said, Valeria provided excellent service whenever she was there and made a positive difference!

It's also worth noting that there are currently some improvements taking place around the resort, including painting, hammering and general updates. While this didn't significantly impact our stay, it's something to be aware of.

Overall, we had a lovely stay and truly appreciated the efforts of the staff who went above and beyond to make our vacation special.

reviews.author: Tyler D
reviews.text:
Our fourth stay at Paradisus Cancun—and somehow it just keeps getting better.
We had an amazing time from start to finish. Having stayed here multiple times (including once on the Family Concierge side), we already had high expectations, and this trip absolutely delivered. The food was consistently very good, the rooms were comfortable and well-kept, and the overall atmosphere continues to strike that perfect balance between relaxing and upscale. But what truly sets this resort apart is the staff—they don’t just provide service, they create unforgettable experiences.
Galdino, our concierge, was exceptional. His attentiveness made the entire trip seamless and stress-free. He handled everything for us—restaurant reservations, Bali bed bookings, and regular check-ins throughout the day to make sure we had everything we needed. This isn’t our first time working with him, and honestly, he’s a big reason we keep coming back. We would only return if we knew we had him—he’s that good.
At Aqua Marina, Juan took great care of our family. He was friendly, attentive, and made every meal enjoyable. It’s service like his that turns a simple dinner into a memorable experience.
Mornings were always brightened by Alejandro and Perla at the café. Their warm welcome each day set the tone perfectly, and they made some of the best coffee we’ve had at any resort. You can tell they genuinely care about guests—it shows in every interaction.
By the pool, Rodrigo, Ana, and Guadalupe were incredible. They were constantly checking in, making sure we had drinks, and keeping the energy fun and relaxed. They made our pool days effortless and enjoyable.
And in the evenings, Flora at the Ginger Bar stood out. She and her team created such a welcoming atmosphere, and the drinks were fantastic. She was kind, engaging, and made everyone feel right at home.
Overall, this was another outstanding stay. We would highly recommend Paradisus Cancun—especially the Reserve side—for any family or couple looking for a relaxing, high-quality, and truly memorable vacation. The people here make all the difference, and it’s why we’ll keep coming back

reviews.text:
Our stay was perfect! Our concierge, Israel, made sure everything was just right! Whenever we needed something, he took care of it! He's amazing!
At the pool, Yeremi took care of us most days! His service is spectacular; he was always making sure we had full drinks and snacks when we needed them. It was fantastic!
The buffet food at breakfast, lunch, and dinner was delicious. At Blue Agave, Armando is a 15 out of 10! He always had a smile on his face. When my daughter's food arrived and the fries were spicy (because of the batter they were fried in), he took care of changing the whole plate! He made our evening very pleasant.

At Kao, Mario was very attentive, and his service was impeccable too!
At Cava, we received excellent service as well!
The ice cream was delicious!!!
At Kidsdom, Esmeralda is great; she has such a positive vibe with the children!
We left more than happy.

The only thing I would recommend is that you do something to control the mosquitoes. Every afternoon/evening we would come back and kill at least 3 to 5 mosquitoes, and I would still wake up covered in bites 😭 Oh, and another thing, the swim-up bar pool is way too deep! You can't walk around comfortably with a drink in your hand 😅

reviews.author: Tayla Covington
reviews.text: I was having an incredible time at Paradisus. This was by far one of the best Mexico vacation's I had ever taken in my life. Unfortunately, my trip was ruined. My daughter had mistakenly left the safe open and the room steward stole our money. It was so suspicious and I knew it was her because she came back to our room when we were in the room to ask if we were okay. At the time I didn't realize the money was taken but I immediately put in a complaint with guest services. They conducted an "investigation" but of course EVEN TO THIS DAY never followed back on this investigation or even attempted to provide me with what they offered as a result of the money being stolen. This ruined my vacation and although I had a fun time at Paradisus and I think that the resort is beautiful, customer experience matters most to me so I am not sure if I will come back until this is addressed.

reviews.author: Thomas
reviews.text:
Our stay at the Paradisus Cancun Resort was a great success overall. The resort is spacious, well-maintained, and boasts a beautiful beachfront location. The rooms are comfortable, and the entire ambiance is inviting and relaxing.

The resort also has a lot to offer in terms of cuisine. We were particularly impressed by the Aqua Marina restaurant – both with the quality of the food and the pleasant atmosphere.

However, special praise is due to the service: Cinthia, our waitress at Aqua Marina, was outstanding. She was always attentive, incredibly friendly, and took great care of us with genuine warmth. Her dedication significantly enhanced our stay and made us feel truly welcome.

Overall, we highly recommend the Paradisus Cancun Resort – especially thanks to the excellent service and the dedicated staff!

Our stay at Paradisus Cancun was truly unforgettable. From the moment we arrived, we were impressed by the exceptional service, attention to detail, and warm hospitality from the staff. The resort is beautifully maintained—everything from the rooms to the common areas was spotless and well cared for.

The atmosphere throughout the resort is relaxing yet vibrant, making it perfect for both families and couples. The staff consistently went above and beyond to ensure we were comfortable and enjoying our time, which made a big difference in our overall experience.

The combination of cleanliness, excellent service, and the stunning beachfront location made this trip absolutely amazing. We left with wonderful memories and would highly recommend Paradisus Cancun to anyone looking for a luxurious and stress-free getaway. We would definitely love to return!

reviews.author: isabel escudero
reviews.text:
Great hotel. You can tell it's been renovated. We had a problem at check-in; they make you check in online before arriving to "save" time, but then you still spend half an hour at reception. Our room wasn't ready yet (even though they ask beforehand what time you'll arrive so they can have it ready), but we were able to use the facilities in the meantime. When we got closer to the time they told us the room would be ready, they still made us wait an hour in the lobby. They didn't give us the room until 4:30 pm. It was a shame because, between one thing and another, we ended up losing almost the entire afternoon, and we were only staying two nights. That first night, we also had to wait an hour for dinner at the Japanese restaurant, and when we finally went, it was practically empty. We specified that we wanted a room with one double bed, and they gave us one with two single beds (they ask you beforehand about that too). Aside from those inconveniences... the Japanese restaurant was delicious. The staff was very friendly, and the buffets were good. The evening entertainment was a bit short. Everything closes at 11 PM.
The facilities are very well maintained. There were enough hammocks for everyone, and they were in excellent condition.

My husband and I went for a vacation to see the hotel's renovations. Everything was great. The first night, Cinthya served us at Aguamarina, providing excellent service. We had lunch at Blue Agave, where Armando served us—a very nice, friendly, and efficient person. We also had dinner at Vibra, where Jorge served us. It's a delicious restaurant with Latin American options.

We stayed at The Reserve, and as always, the service was excellent. Our concierge, Carolina, was outstanding—the best we've ever had. She was always attentive, made all our dinner reservations perfectly, sent us daily activity information, and was always on top of our needs. I highly recommend her. Julio was at the bar, providing impeccable service as always. At the Sante restaurant, Gemma, Javier, Cesar, Yamil, and Valeria served us breakfast—a great team, always very kind.

The pool concierges Victor and Horacio were incredibly friendly, and Jesús from the entertainment service provided excellent and original activities.
I injured my foot and received outstanding care; they were always attentive to my recovery. Diego, the manager of The Reserve, and Farideh from Guest Services were very helpful.
We appreciate the excellent service!

ADAN at the front desk of Paradisus Cancun truly made our stay unforgettable. He went above and beyond to ensure everything was perfect. His professionalism, warmth, and genuine care for guests set him apart immediately.

He was always attentive, quick to assist with any request, and consistently made us feel welcomed and valued. Whether it was offering helpful recommendations, resolving questions efficiently, or simply greeting us with a friendly smile, Adan elevated our entire experience.

It’s rare to encounter someone so dedicated to hospitality, and his efforts did not go unnoticed. Because of him, our stay was not just comfortable but exceptional. I would highly recommend seeking him out if you’re staying at Paradisus Cancun—he will make sure you have the best time possible.

reviews.author: CJ T
reviews.text: I have stayed at this hotel on multiple occasions as it seemed to me to be a benchmark in Canun with respect to; The quality of service, amenities, food, drinks, and comfort—generally speaking, the "plus" service (formerly Royal Service, now The Reserve)—was lacking. I fear this was the last time we were there. The person who greeted us at The Reserve, with a face that suggested they'd been working nonstop for 24 hours (which was likely the case), told us there had been a mistake with the reservations and that they didn't have a room for us in The Reserve. They made us wait almost an hour to see what would happen and then told us they would accommodate us in the standard area with the plus service we had paid for, "a situation that, of course, didn't happen." It's worth mentioning that they moved us on the second night, but what was lost was lost. The quality of the drinks and food has declined drastically. What used to be true room service now resembles a City Express. They didn't even stock the minibars properly. Whereas before you could enjoy, for example, a good wine included in any bar or restaurant, now the entire hotel is served wine of such poor quality that it's best to avoid it. What used to be a truly exquisite breakfast buffet is now, at best, average, and if you want something better, you have to pay extra, like a... The wine for dinner was four times its price, and then, 30 minutes after ordering, they told you they didn't have it, when you were already halfway through your meal. The spa also saw cost-cutting, and it showed. In short, you expect the same level of experience as before, and it's disappointing to see how much money has been cut. Unfortunately, I'll have to look elsewhere.

reviews.author: Mark G
reviews.text: My family and I stayed at the Paradisus for a family vacation. As soon as we arrived, we weren’t off to a great start. We requested two beds, but they insisted the only had a king size room available. Apparently they were doing this to a lot of guests when they arrived. After arguing for about 30 minutes, they accommodated us with a double bed room. As well as the other guests. I guess it’s common practice to argue with the guests when they arrive? I don’t see any other why they insisted they didn’t have any double bed rooms available when they clearly did. The pools were really nice, but some tiles were chipping off. Most disappointing about the resort was the food. It was average at best. The à la carte restaurants were not very good apart from the Blue Agave. One night we tried going to the Italian restaurant and were turned away saying they were overbooked, but the restaurant was about 70% empty. Not exaggerating. Also, you weren’t allowed to make reservations unless you were a member. Which meant the average guest would be stuck eating at the buffet every night. This is a terrible system in my opinion. Forces you to pay extra or settle for the bare minimum. The service overall was subpar. I believe they were understaffed for such a large resort. I know they just reopened in April but clearly they have not got down the routines yet as they were constant lineups everywhere. Nothing was labelled at the food stands or bathrooms. Looking for a bathroom is basically an Easter egg hunt, including which room is male or female. The resort itself was not air-conditioned, despite being enclosed, the elevators are basically small sweat boxes. To top off the resort, one of my family members found cockroaches in the shower on the last day. The resort did have a beautiful piano bar room and the bartenders were very nice as well. The resort needs to be better managed and better staffed and it could be a true 5 star resort. As it is right now, it is maybe 3.5–4 stars at best. I’ve been to about 7 different resorts in Cancun and the Paradisus ranks among the bottom 2. We will not be returning, but hopefully they can get their act together in the future.

reviews.author: Daniel Bazzo
reviews.text:
I recently stayed at Paradisus Cancun and unfortunately had a pretty disappointing experience overall.

On our last night, we found multiple roaches in the room, which was extremely unsettling. The nightlife also ends at 11pm, which makes it difficult to enjoy a proper evening out.

There are some positives, there are decent amenities for kids, and the upgraded slides were a nice touch. The beach itself is beautiful, but seating is very limited. There are not nearly enough umbrellas, which is a big issue when you have kids who can’t stay in the sun all day.

The resort is still under construction, which really takes away from the experience. On top of that, there were two conventions happening during our stay, making it nearly impossible to book reservations. It felt like everything enjoyable required extra money or becoming a member.

We were especially disappointed that we couldn’t enjoy a proper steak dinner as a family because kids aren’t allowed at certain restaurants. For a family resort, that doesn’t make much sense.

There were also safety concerns, tiles in the main pool were broken, and someone actually cut their foot. For a hotel that recently went through renovations, the quality of work seems questionable.

Management was another issue. We had reservations for 15 people at Kow Restaurant for my mom’s 70th birthday, but they split our group up. The same thing happened at the Italian restaurant, where they initially couldn’t accommodate us even though it was empty. After some back and forth, the manager Daniel stepped in and allowed 8 of us to sit at separate tables. He did make an effort by bringing out a surprise cake once he learned about the birthday, which we appreciated, but only 4 of us were actually able to share that moment together.

The staff overall were friendly and constantly asked for reviews, and while they do deserve recognition for their effort, it doesn’t reflect the overall condition and management of the hotel.

Vianney was absolutely incredible. We came in having a pretty rough day, and she completely turned the experience around for us. From the moment she greeted us, she was warm, attentive, and genuinely caring. She went above and beyond to make sure everything was perfect, and her positive energy made a huge difference.

Balthazar also did a great job. He was attentive, professional, and made sure everything ran smoothly throughout our visit.

It’s rare to come across a team that can shift your entire mood like that, but they did just that. Outstanding service and an even better attitude, they truly made our day. We’ll definitely be back because of them.

Between being understaffed, poorly executed renovations, and constant limitations unless you pay extra, I would not recommend this resort unless you’re okay eating buffet food daily and spending more for basic experiences.

reviews.author: Sandra Mohan
reviews.text:
I am writing this review 4 days after returning from our stay, and after reflecting on the experience, my opinion remains the same—disappointing.

My family and I regularly travel to Mexico, so we are well-seasoned travellers and understand what to expect from resorts at this level. Unfortunately, this resort fell short in several key areas.

Service was the biggest issue throughout our stay. Room service consistently took between 1 to 2.5 hours, and the policy of charging after a limited number of orders felt unreasonable. We also travelled with friends who experienced even worse delays, waiting over 5 hours for room service on one occasion. Housekeeping was average at best, and restocking of basic items like water, coffee, and snacks was inconsistent and often overlooked.

The room itself was underwhelming. The shower drain frequently clogged, causing unpleasant odors, and the overall space felt small and not well maintained.
Dining was mixed. The breakfast buffet was excellent, and the dinner buffet was also great. The Italian restaurant was a highlight of our stay. However, many items across other restaurants were unavailable, and vegetarian options were limited. Nighttime entertainment also did not meet expectations.

There were ongoing repairs during the day, and we encountered flooding in hallways without proper safety signage. On the fourth floor, there were severe ceiling leaks that created large puddles of water, posing a safety hazard for guests walking through the area.

Considering the premium price of this resort, this was unacceptable.
The hotel layout was confusing and made getting around inconvenient.
That said, there were some positives. The beach was well maintained with attentive beverage service, and the pools—especially the kids pool and swim-up pool—were excellent. The coffee shop and ice cream parlor were also standout features of the resort.

Tip for future guests: Poolside chairs are often taken very early (before 7:30am) with towels and then left unused, which is very frustrating—especially for families with young children who need seating. If your budget allows, consider renting a cabana (around $300). It’s covered, offers significantly better service, and includes food like lobster, shrimp skewers, fajitas, chips and dip, along with premium top-shelf drinks and consistent staff attention.

Overall, the lack of service, organization, and attention to detail significantly impacted our experience. Based on this stay, I would not recommend this resort.

reviews.author: Imogen Smith
reviews.text:
Amazing resort; the building is an absolute architectural marvel! Staff are so friendly and attentive. Really enjoyed the entertainment, especially water aerobics with Daniel! All the staff are wonderful, friendly, welcoming and any requests we had about the room were answered quickly. We had a broken lock on our balcony door which was attended to and fixed within an hour!

I would say that sometimes the organisation needs work; yesterday the app advised us that a Mario Kart tournament would begin at 8pm, so we planned our evening to attend that, only to turn up and be told it had started at 7 and was over by 8pm, which was disappointing! Small fixes needed but overall an amazing experience!!

reviews.author: Lajos Mága
reviews.text:
It was a very pleasant experience dining here! The food was fresh and delicious, especially the guacamole and the cheese dishes.

The atmosphere is very nice and authentic; it truly makes you feel the Mexican style.

The service deserves a special mention—Miguel, the chef, and the team (Atilano, Guadalupe, and Natanale) were very friendly and attentive at all times.

If you're in Cancun, this place is definitely worth a visit. 🌮

reviews.author: Marshall Eisenberg
reviews.text: Brand new remodel opened April 1, 2026. Great for families as well as the Adult Only Reserve section.

reviews.author: Angeli Dela Cerna
reviews.text:
We stayed for 5 days at the 6th floor of Pyramid 3 which is the central location of the hotel. Our room was spotless everyday and the interior of the hotel looks relaxing and modern. After you’re done with the check in, make sure you download the Melia app to know the activities, events, room service, restaurant menus & opening time. Book dinner reservations right aways for 3 days as booth only opens 9am-4pm. If you arrive later like us, you can try walking in at any restaurants if they have available slot or go to Gastro Hall (buffet) as it doesn't need reservation. As for lunch, you can walk in anywhere as long as it’s open. For excursions, there is an Aquaworld booth near the pool area of the hotel. There building is just located outside the building across the street. If you want to go out, in downtown or mall. Ask the receptionist to book a taxi. for uber, you have to go out the building or ride a bus (R1 or R2) no need to cross the street.

Service: 10/10
Our family (4 adults+1 kid) loved going to Twe12lvet (coffee shop & ice cream shop) because of the Alejandro, Rosalia and Perla. They were always accommodating, hardworking, greets us all the time and smiles a lot even though they’re busy going back & forth in coffee station and ice cream station. We always say that the Twe12lvet is our comfort/happy place especially Alejandro, who takes time to have a quick chat with us. Special mention to Anna at the shack as well, she took care of us for 2 days. We always look for her if we are in the poolside. She’s so sweet, updates us all the time if we need something else and talks to us too.

Check in: 3/10
Check in was frustrating. We arrived at the hotel at around 3pm and it took us around an hour for the check in process. You can just see the staff going in & out of the door behind them. No staff is guiding the guests in line so even if you arrive first, you wont be catered right away, you have to guess where to line up and hope that the receptionist is fast in doing the checkin process. If only there’s no pillar blocking the left side of the counter, we would know who is available.

Restaurant: 10/10
Overall I enjoyed the food so much. We tried everything except SAL & Zesty. All the restaurants have different menus for lunch and dinner. All of the food and the staff were great. Exceptional service from Melvin of Capella and Omar from Vibra. Anna from the shack and Alejandro, Rosalia and Perla from the Twe12lvet.

Noise level: 5/10
We are the 6th floor and from our room we can still hear people outside. May be from the bar area at the 2nd floor.

reviews.author: Siri Potluri
reviews.text:
Whilst the hotel is aesthetically pleasing, and in a great location (beach front), I personally wouldn’t visit again.

On paper there appears to be many restaurants for food choices, however you have to book well in advance to guarantee a place. The additional paying guests who are members of the Reserve get priority at most restaurants which is frustrating given others have also paid for all inclusive.

I felt the food at the restaurants was not good. Kau was good but others were not. The Italian restaurant especially served very bland food, and I ended up leaving how it is possible to make Italian food taste so bad. The dinner buffet is poor quality. So if you cannot reserve a table at the restaurants then you end of needing to go to the very poor buffet.

Most of the food in the restaurants (except kau) was either tasteless, overcooked, very odd taste or tiny portions.

Drinks options were good but no menus provided.

Pool was lovely but guests hog the sunbeds from around 08.00- they leave their towels there the whole day meaning by about 09.00 there is not a single sunbed left to use. On the beach we looked at hiring a beach bed, but it was 250 USD which is extortionate.

You cannot use the spa facilities like the steam room or sauna unless you book an extortionately priced massage or treatment.

The gym was good for a hotel gym.

I enjoyed the ice cream and the cafe.
I enjoyed the pool once i decided to give up on sunbed and use the patch of astroturf under a tree.

I reported a watch missing, and got security involved. All I wanted to know was whether they had cameras and whether somebody had entered my room when I was away. The security team searched our whole room, including our fridge, individual underwears, all corners of our suitcase. They also tried to search my parents rooms in the same manner, even though I told them I had definitely not visited there room and not lost my watch there. They then started to search my parents personal belongings including pill boxes etc. this was highly intrusive. I understand they have a policy to follow, but they did not listen I really don’t see the need for them go through my underwear….

All in all, I still had a good time but I enjoyed Cancun for the beautiful beaches, snorkelling, historical sites. I would not stay at Paradisus Cancun again.

We had an amazing experience at the Italian restaurant in Paradisus Cancun, and a huge part of that was thanks to Edgar!

From the moment we sat down, he made us feel genuinely welcome and taken care of. His attention to detail, friendly attitude, and perfect timing with everything—from drinks to recommendations—made the whole evening smooth and enjoyable. He knew the menu really well and helped us pick dishes that turned out to be absolutely delicious.

What really stood out was how effortless he made everything feel. He was always there when we needed something, but never intrusive—just top-tier service all around.

Edgar truly elevated our dining experience. If you get the chance, definitely ask for him—you won’t be disappointed!

reviews.text:
Excellent resort.

Fantastic location with very easy beach access.

Hotel is fully renovated and beautiful, all the common areas and rooms are luxurious and very comfortable.

Plenty of options for pools, especially in the family areas where there's lots of options for kids of all ages.

The gym is fantastic, very beautiful and lots of brand new machines and equipment.

Excellent common areas, restaurants, and bars. The coffee bar with the ice cream shop is a nice touch.

Shout out to some staff that made my stay extra special. Jared the concierge, David who was working by the pool cabanas by building 5, and Julio who was working the coffee shop/bar in building 5.

Two suggestions for the hotel to make this an even better experience:
- food in the buffet restaurant is often unlabeled so it's not clear what it is, and I found a lot of the stations were half empty and didn't have food
- there's times of day where it's really hard to get food, would be nice to have some more options between 10am and 12pm.

The only reason my overall rating is 4-stars is that the bathroom in the bedroom was clogged for two days... and then the main bathroom toilet was clogged... THEN, the front room bathroom sink was clogged for 2 days. But, worst of all was the INSANELY STRONG SMELL OF RAW SEWAGE (for 4 of the 5 days we were there). reviews.author: PALOMA ARMA UN VIAJE
reviews.text:
Our first day's experience was bittersweet.
Check-in was slow, there were no complimentary drinks, and the staff who greeted us were unfriendly. Making restaurant reservations was similar; the service was completely unfriendly, and they were in person instead of through an app. We got lost trying to find our room because there were no signs, and the bellhop didn't show us around. The buffet had very little variety and the food was just okay.

On the other hand, at the Blue Agave restaurant, Atilano completely transformed our experience. He was incredibly friendly, warm, and proactive, anticipating when our drinks were running low. The passion fruit drinks were delicious—10 out of 10! On the second day, we spent an hour in line to get a snack. Ana at the pool saved the day with her wonderful service.

The hotel has been open for a week now, and the arcade is still closed, with no word on when it will open.

Today's show was a circus in the pool area.

Another unpleasant surprise that night: a pillow smelled terrible. Upon inspection, it had yellow stains from a previous guest. We removed it, but these are hygiene issues that shouldn't occur.

On our second day, Ana's service and friendliness in the pool area (drinks) and Anabel's at Zesty stood out.

We used the kids' club for a couple of hours, and the staff were very friendly. It's well-structured and organized, ideal for children between 3 and 5 years old. There's nothing for older children...

Many areas are still unfinished, electrical outlets are missing covers, hallways are dark, and many dishes listed on the menu are unavailable in the restaurants.

On day 3, the food at Capella was delicious, and Joel's service was incredibly friendly and welcoming. This restaurant has been the most outstanding in terms of food. We loved the pizza, the tomato soup, the picanha, and the pork shank.

It has a very nice atmosphere, unlike Agua Marina and Zesty, which don't have decor that matches what they serve.

reviews.author: Nophar Haimovitz
reviews.text:
Beautiful hotel. Incredible beach. But everything else? Not great.

We arrived opening week and even though we knew there will be some kinks it was just not a good stay. And since this is not a new hotel I don't think it has anything to do with the reopening.
•	Dinner buffet was empty!! (multiple nights) with a huge line.
•	Almost no food during the day (no fruits and one snack bar)
•	Breakfast okay, lunch mediocre
•	Restaurants are hard to book and very slow in service
•	Zero!!! vegetarian options (I barely ate all stay). I had to beg for veggie food every night. They literally have nothing. And I saw a guy asking for a veggie burger and getting meat because the lady didn't understand).
It's ridiculous that at a hotel in Mexico there are very little unripe fruits (I mean no avocado no mango) no rice and beans. Really low quality food at the buffet.

Service was frustrating:
•	Everything had to be asked for multiple times
•	Drinks were warm (no cold beer or cold champagne)
•	No coffee capsules in the room (they were out)

Our Room issues:
We had a huge leak and while they fixed it (yay strangers in my room during vacation for 2 days) we were offered to move to a smaller, worse rooms instead of a real solution bc "we get what we paid for" (we paid a hefty sum!).

Most concerning:
Our 8-year-old got injured at the kids club and fractured his elbow. We spent a day at the local hospital and No follow-up, no real response from staff. No one cared.

Only reason this isn’t a total 0:
Our concierge Alejandro (and Josmarie) were amazing and genuinely tried to help. Without Alejandro this vacation would have been really bad.

There is potential here, the property is beautiful, the Italian & Asian restaurants are good, and the spa was excellent.

But right now? Would not recommend,  especially for families or vegetarians.

reviews.author: Pete Papadopoulos
reviews.text:
The resort was recently remodeled and it just reopened about a week ago. I went there with my wife and two kids. The service was terrible. It was very slow. It took forever to check in. We were only there a few nights and we were unable to book any restaurants because they were "full", but half the tables in the restaurants were not filled.

The bathroom on floor 0 is disgusting and has a foul odor that you can smell from a distance from the bathroom.

Getting bottles of water from anywhere in the resort is impossible.They are either "out" at every bar or they just don't want to give it out.

The pools are nice and clean. The kid area is good. The food and drink service is awful. It takes forever to get drinks. While seated, you cannot order any food, you have to go to the snack shack, which serves burgers, tenders, fries, etc. The food was good, BUT you have to wait for over an hour in line to get the food because they have two people working the snack shack.

The hours of the bars, restaurants are awful.

We changed our flight and left early. Don't stay here.

reviews.author: Lauren Gaston
reviews.text:
We booked Paradisus for the last 3 days of our trip in Mexico and overall had a fantastic stay. Probably easier to start with the cons as there were so many positives:

- could tell they were rushing to reopen ahead of renovations. Given hotel was closed for better part of 10months due to renovations. There was still some ongoing maintenance, likes of ladders and painters not having finished.
- this sort of bled through to a few of the touches that were missing. We had espresso pods in the room but not coffee machine. Beer and water bottles which required a bottle opener, but no bottle opener. They let us know upon check in that 24 hour room service was available but then once the main buffet was closing and we were looking to order some dinner, the phone line was permanently engaged and once we went through reception, wait time for food was over an hour.
- couldn’t get dinner reservations.

That really is it with regards to cons however. The positives far overruled.
- excellent food variety and drinks.
- quality of food was high
- staff were incredibly helpful and friendly
- amenities were all very clean with a fully incredibly well equipped gym.
-availability of 24 hour coffee in the coffee shop.
- cannot comment on the à la carte restaurants as unfortunately they were fully booked for duration of our stay but they looked very nice.

Our room was beautiful and overall we had an amazing stay and would definitely recommend the hotel and would return if we were to go back to cancun.

reviews.author: Wade Ha
reviews.text:
It was a truly satisfying trip.

I would like to leave a few comments in the hope that Paradisus Cancun will become an even more famous and wonderful resort. I visited this place with a friend and stayed for four days.

Having traveled to Cancun about five times, I have stayed at everything from mid-range to the most expensive luxury resorts. Based on this experience, I compared Paradisus Cancun to other places.

1. System

Perhaps because the resort recently reopened, its systems are significantly lacking compared to other resorts. I stayed here on a weekday, and the experience of having to search for a restaurant that was fully booked because I could not make a reservation for dinner was not pleasant.

In particular, the fact that meal reservations and event attendance bookings cannot be made via the smartphone application was very inconvenient compared to other resorts. It was truly unpleasant to have to wait for over an hour at the concierge from the morning just to make a reservation for dinner.

2. Information

It was difficult to read the map, whether in the application or the catalog. I had to search for quite a while because I didn't know where or on which floor the restaurant was located, and it was difficult to find out when and where various events were being held. The information provided by the smartphone application was complex and difficult to view at a glance.

3. Food/Dessert

The quality of the food and desserts was excellent. The ingredients were fresh, and it did not feel like cheap ingredients were being used. You can usually tell immediately if cheap ingredients are being used for desserts, but these were incredibly delicious.

Room service was also very neat and delicious, so I was satisfied.

4. Staff

All the staff worked incredibly hard, to the point where they looked exhausted.

In particular:

Front Desk - Roberto: He was very responsible and instilled confidence.

KAO Bar - Salvador: He was friendly and brought joy to those waiting.

It was pitiful to see the staff responding kindly even when guests who couldn't get dinner reservations were making strong complaints (even though this wasn't the fault of either the guests or the staff).

5. Overall Review

Like me, people visit Paradisus Cancun to spend a lot of money on a vacation. While everyone has different expectations, I believe Paradisus Cancun pursues one single direction: customer satisfaction.

To become a resort that everyone wants to visit, improvements are needed in the areas that are currently problematic. I believe that with just a little more development, it could become the best resort.

The staff are truly doing their best, but it was disappointing that the resort's internal systems did not seem to be functioning 100%.

I don't usually write reviews like this, but I am leaving this one because I believe it could become perfect with just a few changes. If I have the opportunity to visit again, I hope the issues I pointed out have been improved to surprise me. I especially hope the resort continues to improve, for the sake of all the staff members who were so kind to me.

The restaurant Aqua Marina at the Paradisus Hotel was absolutely excellent. From the moment we arrived, the atmosphere felt relaxed, elegant, and perfect for a beachfront dining experience. The views of the ocean made the entire meal even more special.

The food was fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented. Every dish we tried was delicious, and you could really taste the quality of the ingredients. The seafood, in particular, was outstanding and cooked perfectly. The menu had a great variety, so there was something for everyone.

The service was also exceptional, especially from Juan Carlos. He was friendly, attentive, and made us feel very welcome throughout the entire meal. Juan Carlos went above and beyond to make sure everything was perfect and truly enhanced our dining experience. 👏

reviews.text:
This is our 7th trip here, and unfortunately, it’s been the worst resort experience we’ve had so far. Two of the six restaurants aren’t available to general guests, Vibra (the snack hut) is almost always closed, and the remaining restaurants rarely have reservations—even when the resort is only half full.
On the few occasions we were able to dine, most menu items were unavailable, leaving us with very limited options unless we paid extra. The entertainment is nonexistent and feels quite amateur compared to other resorts we’ve visited.
Room service has been unreliable and often never arrives, making the overall experience frustrating and disappointing. Cancun is full of amazing resorts and is a beautiful place to vacation, but this property has been a complete letdown. I would strongly recommend considering other options.

reviews.author: Sam Michlig
reviews.text:
The hotel is saved by it's fantastic hard working restaurant and bar staff. Every morning for breakfast (and often lunch) we relaxed on the outdoor terrace at the Buffet restaurant and were looked after by Alberto and Joni who were an absolute pleasure to talk to and excellent hosts. Thank you also to them from our 2 young children who were treated just as well as the grown ups.

We also enjoyed Aqua Marina where we were looked after by Erick, Wilbert and Sergio during the lunch service and Roberto in the evening.

Jesus at Capello, Melvin at Cielo and Daniel at Lemon Fish also are fantastic waiters.

For the people above, and for many more incredibly hard working staff around the pool and beach - they are working at 5 star standard all day long. Management need to look to themselves for areas that are making global review scores lower - and take the pressure off their employees.

The issue here at management level is greed. On the run up to the stay there was frequent contact from concierge services but only with a view to selling room upgrades or experience packages. Simple requests like a room on a higher floor or in a quieter area were squarely ignored once it was clear that no further cash could be extracted.

Fending off regular approaches from the 'circle club' sales team to attend seminars - not what I want to do on holiday. Some staff are clearly under pressure to sell upgrades for wine or 'chefs specials' and the daily rounds from the Spa and watersports excursions team. It can all lead to the need to say no thank you 10 times a day and walk around not making eye contact to avoid sales approaches.

The big problem with our stay was the room we were allocated on the first night. It was actively dirty with blood on the vanity worktop. Light switches were cracked, lamps didn't work and I killed 5 cockroaches in the bathroom. It was an extremely unpleasant environment and to top it all - incredibly noisy. This room was in dire need of renovation and shouldn't be in use currently for paying guests.

The response from reception was very disinterested - they processed a room change request which required me to return to reception at 0900 and again at 1500 to move room. Very disruptive to the holiday and absolutely zero concern about the state of the room. The reception team even suggested the next room might be in the same condition so there was no point moving. No apology was ever offered either.

The complaints process was dissatisfactory and I have since received a refund via my credit card company for the night spent in a dirty room. The hotel refused to refund but offered an upgrade voucher for a future stay which i declined.

The hotel itself occupies a huge amount of beach front and as a result has stunning views from all around the pool areas and lots of the dining and drinking areas. The building is old but there is a constant effort being made to maintain improve and re-paint areas. The food was excellent. Drinks selection also fantastic and the bar tenders in the mixology bar made incredible cocktails. Kanna Beach Bar is the perfect spot for the final drink before getting ready for the evening.

reviews.author: Taylor Vision
reviews.text:
Paradisus is a BEAUTIFUL place!!! I really enjoyed my week long stay. I was there from the 2nd to the 9th of September and I had an amazing time. There’s just a few things that I experienced that made me give it 4 stars. 1st, when we booked our room, we asked for a king bed ocean view. On the site they said that we should call at least a week before we get there to verify the room. We called at least every other day until it was time to fly out and when I say NOBODY answered the phones so we could verify the room. NOBODY!!!

Once we got there I was amazed by the beauty, but they put us in a room with two queen beds when we asked for a king bed. Once we got to the room we noticed that the beds weren’t queen size beds but full size and two adults can’t sleep in those beds together. The 1st night was rough because our room would not get cold. It was hot, unbearable, we couldn’t stay sleep. The next day we went to get our room changed and they said they we could change it on Sunday. I asked can we stay on the same floor because we love the view from that level. Nora at the front desk said everything was in our file and everything would be fine come Sunday. Sunday came and they tried to put us on the 2nd floor. We told them that Nora put it in our file but they couldn’t find it. So we didn’t get our king size bed until Tuesday. I LOVE the view, we were on the 6th floor. GREAT VIEW!!!

Initially we thought that it was just our room that was hot but it was the entire main building that was hot, it felt like we were outside at times. We asked why it was always hot and we were told that it was just the main building because it was hard to keep it cool but the other building were colder.

The food options in the buffet was subpar and I felt it could be better, we went to Xplor Park for an excursion and their buffet was superior to Paradisus. The buffet did have a lot of food but the quality in taste wasn’t the best and majority of the food didn’t have labels, so you didn’t know what you were eating. Out of all the restaurants there only Lemon Fish & Agua Marina is worth eating at.

They could have had more activities at the resort for people to do besides eating, pool & beach. At night it’s pretty boring, while they do have a few live acts but nothing to be exited for. I’m not saying they should rock out or have a wild party but have more options on the activities.

I love this place but the heat inside the main building, lack of food choices & activities is the only downside. I would go back but I’ll bring more appropriate clothing to deal with the heat inside the building. Great place to RELAX, we enjoyed ourselves
