We had booked the Premium Junior Suite Sunset View, which was supposed to have a jacuzzi and kitchenette, but when we arrived, the room had neither. At reception, we were met with nothing but excuses, claiming the room was in the category we had paid for, but it was obvious it wasn't. They were giving us a lower-category room with fewer amenities. The next day, they moved us to the correct room, but they ruined the experience since we had chosen that room specifically for the jacuzzi, and they didn't even compensate us in any way for their mistake. Honestly, their poor service really dampened the mood of our anniversary trip for the first few days. Several days, they didn't refill the minibar; we had to call room service to get water because they wouldn't refill it.

The other facilities and staff service at the pool and restaurant were very good. I expected the food to be more delicious, but it was just average.

The hotel is very beautiful and its pools are large and spacious, but unfortunately that mistake and poor service in the lobby did affect us. We won't be returning; next time we'll look for other options.

reviews.text: Everything about Paradisus Cancun was wonderful! The servers came to the pool to take drink and snack orders starting at 10am. We lived on Pina Coladas, Mango Daiquiris, Sweet Tea, Nachos and Guacamole everyday. Restaurants were delicious but the buffet was our go-to. Lots of choices, no reservations needed and service was fantastic. Rooms were large and the Oceanview balcony was gigantic. My mother-in-law had timeshare so we were members of CLUB MELIÁ during our one week stay and was appointed a private concierge named “RODOLFO”. He was simply the best and made our vacation so easy and relaxed. RODOLFO texted us every morning when he arrived at the resort and asked if we needed anything. He made all our dinner reservations and he booked us 2 Bali Beds for the week. RODOLFO made sure to walk by at least 2 times a day to make sure we were happy and all our needs were met. We also had the ability to text him 24/7 if we needed anything at all and RODOLFO always answered promptly and professionally. We had mentioned my daughter would be celebrating a birthday and turning 17 on our last day. We were pleasantly surprised when we returned to our room and discovered RODOLFO had decorated the place with balloons, banners, towel animals, rose petals, cake and champagne! He also made us dinner reservations at LemonFish so we could enjoy sushi on this special night. This was the sweetest and kindest gesture and RODOLFO made her 17th birthday in Cancun so wonderful! When we return to Paradisus Cancun after the renovations, we will definitely request RODOLFO to be our concierge again. He went over and above our expectations and was extremely good at his job! He was quite an asset to CLUB MELIÁ. We are looking forward to returning in a year when the resort reopens all fresh and new. reviews.author: William Ruddell
reviews.text: We just came home from a 44th wedding anniversary trip to the all-inclusive Paradisus Cancun. We were picked up in a timely manner by Optium, the  transportation service that works for Melia hotels.  We were given a room on the bottom floor, 40005. At first, we weren’t sure we liked it, but in the end, we were very happy with it. We still had an ocean view, and the room was  larger than the rooms in the higher floors. It was also a short walk to the gym and one floor below Malva, where they serve delicious Buffet style food for breakfast, lunch and dinner. There are other restaurants, and we tried the  Lemon fish which we liked, but we ate all the rest of our meals at the  Malva.  There are many options for alcohol consumption, but as we don’t drink alcohol, we spent most of our time getting lattes at the Nespresso stand. The person who worked at that stand in the afternoons and evenings was named  Perla.  She did an exceptional job preparing our lattes just the way we wanted them cold or hot. Yes we actually like drinking lattes hot even in the tropical climate. We also had a wonderful massage and relaxing water therapy at the Yhi spa, an experience  you would do well to consider taking advantage of. For our 44th wedding anniversary, they gave us a beautiful cabana just above and overlooking the beach and the ocean.  It was in the Reserve, So we had a server who brought us drinks and a lunch of fish tacos, and guacamole and chips. When we got back to our room after a day at the beach, we found a bottle of champagne and an artistically designed tray of chocolates!  That happened to be the last day of our stay at the hotel. But the day before, we had come to the conclusion that we wanted to be members of the Melia Circle. We have been to Melia hotels in Spain and always enjoyed the experience and quality they offered. So we decided we would get the exceptional discounts and benefits that are offered to Melia Circle members. Those include five or six free vacations for one week at 22 all-inclusive hotels over the first five years of the contract. Those alone are more than the investment we made in becoming members of Melia Circle. There are so many other benefits that we can’t possibly take advantage of them all. But one includes two weeks of vacation  a year at $499 for up to six people at hotels on the RCI platform, which are located around the world.  Sound too good to be true. It isn’t!  By the way, I wouldn’t be writing any of this if Perla, from the  Nespresso stand in the hotel had not giving me the QR code. She is an example of the exceptionally high-quality of staff that served us while we were there. We look forward to our next free one week vacation at an all-inclusive Melia resort in April of next year.

reviews.author: Brooke Sweeney
reviews.text:
Paradisus Cancun – A Mixed Experience at a Beautiful Resort
My family and I recently returned from a stay at Paradisus Cancun, and I wanted to share an honest review of our experience. First and foremost, we’re incredibly grateful to have had the opportunity to go on a vacation and enjoy an all-inclusive resort. We realize that many of our disappointments are minor in the grand scheme of things. However, when staying at a resort that markets itself as a luxury destination, expectations are naturally higher—and in this case, many of those expectations were not met.
We were a group of five—four adults and one toddler—with two members having stayed at Paradisus properties more than five times. So, we came in with excitement and a sense of familiarity with the brand.
Highlights:
•	The beach was absolutely beautiful and one of the resort’s best features.
•	The food was quite good for an all-inclusive—definitely a positive.
•	The included sunset cruise that came with the concierge upgrade was a standout experience.
•	Evening shows and poolside entertainment were enjoyable and well-executed.
•	The massages we received at the spa were truly exceptional—some of the best we've ever had, and a real highlight of the trip.
•	Rosanna, one of the concierges, was a bright spot in our experience. She was kind, thoughtful, and went out of her way to make our stay special—especially for our toddler, leaving little gifts that made a big impression.
Areas of Disappointment:
Service:
Unfortunately, the service was inconsistent and often disappointing. While I understand the resort may have been understaffed due to an upcoming closure, the larger issue was not delays—it was the overall attitude of the staff. Many seemed unhappy or disengaged, and we felt more like a burden than a welcomed guest.
We upgraded to the concierge package, which turned out to be a poor value. We didn’t meet our assigned concierge, Galdino, until the final day—and only because we encountered an issue. That brings me to the biggest frustration: pool and beach daybeds.
Daybed Policy and Experience:
We used a daybed every day of our 6-day stay, only to be told on the final day that we were no longer allowed to reserve one. Suddenly, we were informed that the concierge upgrade only allows one daybed per room per stay—something we were never told at check-in. To make matters worse, there were multiple empty daybeds at the pool, and beach-facing beds were entirely vacant. Yet, they were asking $300 to reserve one. Frankly, that felt outrageous.
At a resort that claims to offer a luxury experience, this was a major letdown. A more thoughtful approach—such as offering complimentary access to loyal returning guests or reducing the rental cost—could have turned this into a memorable perk rather than a source of frustration.
Eventually, we were granted access to one of the unused daybeds, but only after considerable back and forth. It shouldn't have required that level of effort.
Final Thoughts:
The resort itself is beautiful, though it could use some updating in certain areas. The entertainment and setting provided some great moments, and the concierge sunset cruise was a real highlight. That said, the service experience and inconsistent policies left us disappointed—especially given the premium pricing.
We truly hope to see Paradisus return to the level of quality and service we’ve come to expect in the past. Until then, we’ll likely look elsewhere for future vacations.

reviews.author: Star AV
reviews.text:
As our trip was within a week of Paradisus closing for their year long remodel, we expected things might not be perfect.
The rooms are definitely in need of rehab, but were fine for our stay in the Reserve.

Positives:
Paradisus staff was wonderful. We tipped a lot, because we felt their service deserved it. Note: Tipping is not required and I did not ever feel pressed to tip.

Property location is wonderful and interior is great (see photos)

As far as any negatives:
The food presentation was great, but the taste fell into the "Edible but just ok". Everyone in our group did not feel any of the food "wowed" us. Hopefully the remodel will include improvements in the food taste quality.

Another negative was the constant pushing to checkout the Circle program. I said we were not interested. If it would have stopped there, I might have checked it out. But the young lady (who I will not name, as she was just doin her job), kept seeking us out, to the point that I now have a negative view of a program I now know nothing about. So my advice to Melia- ask clients once, maybe offer literature and maybe coupons for the freebees for listening, noting they are redeemable at Circle presentation. And then let your guests enjoy their trip versus constantly pushing upgrades around every corner.

If I were to pick top eats it would be Lemon Fish. I do have to note that all the restaurant staff that we engaged with at Malva, Sal, Blue Agava, Cielo, Cappella, Sante, Reserve Atrium and Agua Marina, were all welcoming and friendly.

All the Paradisus staff, from housekeeping, restaurants, bars & everywhere on the property were friendly and helpful. They seemed to be pretty happy considering they were going to be out of a job in 7 days due to the remodel. All said they would be happy to come back if they were not working elsewhere.

"David" the Reserve pool concierge was definitely a highlight. He always had a Bali Bed for us and gave us info on how to get around Cancun. Very professional and personable.

For the price we paid through Expedia which included airfare, I am very happy with the service and trip value we received.

Cancun was wonderful, love their bus system (fast and fun) and friendly attitude of the locals everywhere we went: Isla Mujeres, Market28 and Senior Frogs

reviews.text: Cynthia,Fanny and Annabelle provided the best dinner service we had here in Paradisus Cancún! The restaurant Flora was also the best food we’ve here at the resort, from the tasty appetizers, entrees (best dish was the noodles in spinach sauce with picanha), to the desserts, everything was excellent. The atmosphere was breezy, relaxing and felt intimate and quiet. They also made my nieces birthday dinner celebration special by having a cake and singing for her. Thank you to all the workers who run the place so smoothly with their professionalism & dedicated hardwork! We had a great time in Paradisus ☻

reviews.author: Caitlin Peratt
reviews.text: Abraham y Karina are both amazing from Ginger bar. They exceed expectations and experiences. They are the best. Abraham is the sweetest and friendliest bartender ever. Karina is the nicest and most loving bartender as well. I highly recommend coming to see them here at Paradisus!!!

reviews.author: Portia
reviews.text: Abraham and Karina at Ginger’s are the BEST!! We came here every night and it did not disappoint.

reviews.author: Frankie Belluomini
reviews.text: Abraham and Karina from ginger 2 gave us the best experience out of the whole resort! The best energy, drinks, and atmosphere. They are an asset to the resort!

reviews.author: Naomi Green
reviews.text: Blue agave at the Paradisus Cancun hotel was our favorite of the trip! We started there and ended there and celebrated our daughter’s 6th birthday with an extra special candle! Our waiter for both nights was Atilano and restaurant captained by Teresa. Service was excellent and we truly enjoyed both times! Will hopefully be back  very soon!

reviews.author: Giselle Cortez
reviews.text: Excellent service! Cinthia helped us several times with great attention and quality. Thank you!

reviews.author: Andres Espinoza
reviews.text: Jorge at the lemon fish has an amazing service!! Carlos at the bar as well! Food is amazing! 100% recomended to anyone looking to have a tasty dinner!

reviews.author: Cintia Martinez
reviews.text: Excellent service at Flora restaurant, the food and desserts were delicious, and the service was outstanding, especially from Cynthia and Fanny ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

reviews.author: Keke
reviews.text: We had the absolute delight of being served by Cynthia at Flora tonight while enjoying our stay at Paradisus Cancun and she was exceptional! Her recommendations were top tier, phenomenal service with a genuine smile throughout the meal, and the food itself was beyond delicious!! Highly recommend! We had the pole bowl, charcoal prawn, spinach noodles with beef and finished it all off with pavlova and the wine pear for dessert. So very good!

reviews.author: LIN WANG
reviews.text: Cinthia in Flora restaurant is very kind and nice! We love her so much!!!

reviews.author: Tacho Reyecito

reviews.author: Delfina Silikovich
reviews.text: An incredible experience!! We spent the whole day at Kanna Beach Club, where Alfredo took care of us. The food was spectacular, the drinks delicious, and the service top-notch. Highly recommended!!

reviews.author: Abby Olmstead
reviews.text: Jorge was amazing from Lemon Fish and Carlos crushed the drinks!!

reviews.author: Roxy NC
reviews.text: Excellent service, food, drinks and clean areas.

reviews.author: Luke Telford
reviews.text: Jorge from Lemon Fish was great with his service, thank you Chef Karen for the ceviche and Mario for the chicken yakitori, see you soon….

reviews.author: RICARDO Q
reviews.text:
Upon arrival, I was told at reception that my room was ready, but when they showed it to me, it only had one bed, even though I had booked a room with two. They said they would add an extra bed and brought me a cot, which I refused. The reception staff told me that was all they had, and they were very negative. However, I explained my situation to Mr. Guillermo and Rubén from the Malva restaurant, telling them I would be leaving the next day. They said it was impossible for them to help me with my issue, and if it weren't for them, my vacation would have been awful. Throughout my stay, they were attentive to my family, always kind, helpful, and following up on everything we needed.

They helped me with the problems I had with the poor treatment I received at the reservations reception desk.

reviews.author: Hefzi Almazán Flores
reviews.text: The hotel is beautiful, superbly located, and has a wonderful atmosphere. The facilities are being remodeled soon, so it will be even more amazing. The food is very good; I highly recommend the tacos, and Cynthia's service was excellent.

reviews.author: Monica Motyer
reviews.text:
Very impressed with our food at Flora. Upgraded to the filet mignon and beyond worth it. Best steak I've had in some time. The service and Fanny, our hostess was lovely and Alex our waiter went above and beyond. Looking forward to our next visit.

Edited to add more about the rest of the resort:

I cannot say enough good things about this resort. I don't have a single complaint about anything from service, to food etc. This was mine and my partners first time in Mexico and the staff made it such an amazing trip, we cannot wait to go back! We chose this resort for many reasons but one of many being the swim up bar that we never ended up using! Luis and Alejandro at the reserve bar as well as all the Sante staff, Gemma, Josue, Rigoberto,  Arnulfo and everyone took such great care of us we never left the reserve pool. Isaac set us up in a beautiful ocean view room and David was always setting us up with the best Bali beds. He and everyone worked tirelessly to ensure we had the absolute best stay. We were so impressed with absolutely everyones work ethic. Julio and everyone at the reserve lounge was phenomenal and so attentive to our needs we never left the reserve side. Felipe and Raul were so helpful with our luggage and shuttle, everything was handled with such care. Emmanuel went above and beyond to take care of us and helped my boyfriend plan the most magical private dinner on the beach. Abraham at Ginger lounge gave us the most informative and entertaining tequila tasting. Danny flow and Say made every day so fun and Danny made us laugh every time we got to see him. He and everyone helped make our trip so memorable that we cannot wait for the next trip to Paradisus! I wish I had gotten more names of everyone that helped us during our stay but we wish everyone luck during their renovations and we hope to see everyone back when we come again! Thank you Paradisus Cancun!!

reviews.author: Jigneshpatel Naini
reviews.text:
I had an excellent dining experience at Cielo and Blue agave,  and a big part of that was thanks to our server, Atilano. They were incredibly attentive, polite, and knowledgeable about the menu, offering great recommendations that made our meal even more enjoyable. Their friendly attitude and professionalism truly stood out and made us feel welcomed and well taken care of.

Highly recommend asking for Atilano and Julio(Reserve cafe) if you visit—you won’t be disappointed!

reviews.author: Julissa Castellanos
reviews.text: Paradisus Cancún was beyond any expectations I had. the scenery, service and aesthetic were exceptional. The restaurants offered excellent food and quality service with waiters being extra attentive to your needs such as Jorge at Lemon Fish. Cinthia at Blue Agave and Flora blew my expectations over what quality service really means. Cinthia was amazing and extra attentive. A service that I don’t think I’ve ever experienced before. Not to forget the hostesses Fanny and Tere. All the staff here was extremely friendly and made sure to ensure you had a quality stay. I can’t wait to return in the future when the remodeling is done.

reviews.author: cynthia galvez
reviews.text:
Cynthia and Fannie were our servers in both Blue Agave and Flora. They were extremely attentive and anticipated our requests.
Cynthia especially took extra care of us while we attended both restaurants. Thank you for making our trip extra special.

reviews.author: Diogo Coelho
reviews.text:
Decorated with plants, good lighting, excellent beach, with activities within the hotel (for those who enjoy them), it has a gym, restaurants with typical local food and a buffet with a wide variety of options.

The people are super friendly and welcoming!

The rooms are older, where some wear and tear on the materials is noticeable, etc.

Ideal for relaxing and enjoying the magnificent views.

There is also the possibility of going on excursions, and outside the hotel on the main street there is a bus that goes to the central market of Cancun as well.

They are LGBT friendly.

reviews.author: Boris Khodorkovsky (netocrat)
reviews.text:
The hotel is nice, spacious, well-designed. The service is good, though we had some issues and misleading directions at the reception several times. Most restaurants are good, we would not recommend the “Italian” one for both unwelcoming service, weird “rules”, and very average food that does not withstand even a very loose critique.

They will be renovating all of the hotel in summer 2025, therefore they most likely will fix most of the issues.

The rooms had even natural sunscreen and natural repellent sprays.

reviews.author: Erika Prats
reviews.text: Excellent service from all the staff, from the moment we arrived to the incredibly friendly Venecia's warm welcome. A special mention goes to Cynthia, who served us at Flora restaurant; we loved her suggestions and she provided outstanding service. It's clear she loves her job. We'll definitely be back.

reviews.author: Adriana Lomeli
reviews.text:
I loved the service at this restaurant; the food was delicious, and our waiter, Jorge, was very attentive and helpful. Excellent service.
Lemon Fish Restaurant.

reviews.text: Super nice place to be at. Enjoy it with the family. So many options to eat I love it. I love to come back again.

Jorge was amazing at attending us !

Lemon  Fish Bar !!!!! 😀

reviews.author: Claudia Gomez
reviews.text: Our experience at Flora Restaurant was wonderful, thanks to Cinthia, who recommended the best dishes. Everything was delicious, and the service was amazing.

reviews.author: Luis Alexander
reviews.text: The day pass is totally worth it! And Bryan provided excellent service; his food recommendations were absolutely delicious! It's worth every penny! And the service is superb both on the beach and at the pool.

reviews.author: Brandon Escobar
reviews.text:
I'm so grateful for the service from Abraham and Karina at the ginger bar. Every time we've been there, they've treated us incredibly well, and we always leave extremely satisfied!
I also want to thank the entire activities team—Dani, Uriel, Sayani, and everyone else—who have such a great vibe and are absolutely wonderful people. Without a doubt, the experience at the hotel, along with all the kitchen and wait staff, has been incredible. We're leaving with very high expectations and eager to return! Thank you so much for everything!

reviews.author: VICTOR ROMERO
reviews.text: Incredible service, location, and attention from all the staff. A fully equipped gym is a must. The best place to have dinner is Lemon Fish; Jorge's special attention made me try everything, and he even prepared the sushi specially for us, even though it wasn't on the menu. Chef Mario gave it every star. A place you'll want to come back to again and again. Thank you for all the wonderful service.

reviews.author: agustin esquivel
reviews.text:
I recently went to Lemon Fish and it was truly an amazing experience. The food was exquisite, the atmosphere very pleasant, but what made all the difference was the service from our waiter, Jorge. From the very first moment, he was incredibly attentive, friendly, and professional. He made us feel comfortable, recommended dishes with confidence and great taste, and was always attentive without being intrusive.

It's a pleasure to find people who love what they do and it shows. Thank you, Jorge, for making our dinner so special. I will definitely return and recommend it.

Rafael Wilber is an excellent waiter.

Deserves every cent of his tip

They are the best bartenders that I have ever met and definitely need to check them out! They made me really good pina coladas and Paloma’s. Definitely made my trip and one of the best things that Paradisus Cancún has to offer.

reviews.author: Paige Boos
reviews.text: We were at the restaurant Flora inside the Paradisus on vacation. Cinthia was wonderful, very prompt, and recommended some dishes that were fantastic.

reviews.author: Rosita SM.
reviews.text: I loved the hotel. I thoroughly enjoyed my room, the beach, the food, and the staff. The food at Sante was delicious, and the captains Diego, Samantha, Gabriela, Adriana, and Daniel were very attentive. The waitresses Gladys and Karina were lovely and helpful. And the mixologist Abraham made delicious cocktails. Highly recommended; I will definitely return.

reviews.author: Miguel SNL
reviews.text: A highly recommended place, with excellent service and a warm and welcoming staff. The room was comfortable, the view was excellent, and the beach was beautiful. My favorite place to eat was Capella. And the Ginger bars were great for a pleasant time. I appreciate the hospitality of the captains Diego, Samantha, Gabriela, Adriana, and Daniel, the waitresses Karina and Gladys, and the mixologist Abraham. I will return for the grand reopening!

reviews.author: Vi Bob Esponja Leyva
reviews.text: I'm thrilled with the hotel and especially with the people I met there. They're all wonderful people who are incredibly helpful. Rodolfo Medina, our concierge, was so attentive that we already miss him. I don't have enough space to mention everyone, but the service was outstanding.

My wife and I would like to thank Ivonne, Alberto, and Francisco at the Malva restaurant for their wonderful service and for being so friendly and welcoming during our stay. Thank you again for everything. Excellent work.

reviews.author: Cassandra Rodriguez
reviews.text: The experience at Lemon Fish was exceptional. Jorge was incredibly attentive, making my first time at the restaurant memorable. For our farewell, Bernardo and Ramiro were very kind and welcoming at Malva. They gave us a framed gift wishing us a safe trip. Alejandro, the barista, was equally friendly. He remembered how much we liked the coffee when we returned the next day. The waiter at De Sante gave me a "boom boom" shot, making our night full of happiness and laughter. We hope to return soon!

reviews.author: Mirna Hervas
reviews.text: Excellent service from Brayan at the beach club, very attentive to everything! Thank you for everything, we loved it!

reviews.author: Leonel Ghiorzi
reviews.text: The hotel is in a prime location, the beach has turquoise water, and the facilities are very nice. The service from the staff, especially in the restaurants, is very, very good. For example, we had contact with Adriana at the Italian restaurant, and she truly goes above and beyond for the company, providing the best possible service. However, the concierges leave much to be desired; they only care about you being part of the Meliá group, and nothing else matters to them. We came to celebrate a birthday with a special price notice and reminder the day before, and they forgot—an unforgivable and unacceptable mistake.

reviews.author: Erick Sickta
reviews.text:
I want to sincerely thank the entire hotel team; they are truly amazing!

A very special thank you to Flora Restaurant, where we received impeccable service from Fany and Cinthia. They were so welcoming and made our dinner a truly special occasion.

On the beach, Irina served us with great kindness and always made sure we had ice-cold beer—thank you for your wonderful attention!

At Blue Agave Restaurant, we also received a warm welcome and enjoyed delicious dishes.

Everything was simply wonderful. I am so grateful for our stay at the Meliá Paradisus and for the professional, friendly, and dedicated team who made our vacation an unforgettable experience.

Thank you so much for everything!

reviews.author: Julio C C
reviews.text: Fanny and Alex provided excellent service at Flora restaurant. Overall, the service was good to average, but theirs was particularly outstanding. The food was also very good. My only complaint would be about the upkeep of the facilities, which appear to be deteriorating, and the air conditioning, which wasn't very effective.

reviews.author: Martha Treviño

reviews.author: Miguel Baeza Aguilera
reviews.text: Ginger bar in the Paradisus Resort. Highly recommend this bar! Abraham, Karina and Laura were our servers and bartenders. Amazing people with great customer service. Very friendly and always attentive to make sure we had a drink in our hand. I would definitely come back to a great place with these amazing individuals. 11/10 I recommend them!

reviews.author: Lilia
reviews.text: Abraham, Karina, y Laura de Ginger Bar were the best!! They were very knowledgeable about mixology and make sure we had a great experience. I would definitely come back!!

reviews.author: Noélly Mercer
reviews.text:
Hello,
I experienced a serious issue during my check-in related to room access, but fortunately, everything was resolved promptly and with great care.

I would like to highlight the outstanding service provided by Francisco. He was extremely professional, kind, and attentive throughout the entire situation. His empathy and commitment to resolving the issue, always emphasizing the team spirit of Paradisus, made all the difference.

Thank you, Paradisus, for turning around my initial impression and making my stay truly enjoyable.

I definitely plan to return to Cancún, and it would be a pleasure to stay at Paradisus again.

The restaurants are excellent, and the service at the pool, breakfast, and all dining venues was impeccable. The food quality was truly exceptional in every detail.

Thank you once again!

reviews.author: Julissa Contreras
reviews.text: A very good hotel—the food, the facilities, the cleanliness; but above all, the staff's attention. Everyone is always very friendly and attentive. I especially want to highlight the service provided by Mr. Gerardo at the Malva restaurant, who served us from day one, always attentive and helpful!

reviews.author: Christian Navarrete
reviews.text: This place was more than amazing. I'm glad I chose this hotel. This was our first time in Cancun and we ended up staying an extra night. The building needs some updates but regardless it's a breathtaking building. Service is top notch. Food was amazing, drinks were great. Made us feel like a VIP the whole week. Beach is amazing btw. Special shoutout to Armando Candelario at the Malva Buffet Restaurant. He was our first encounter and offer the best service ! Amazing human being I hope to see him soon again when they finish remodeling the place next year.

reviews.author: Denilson Pereira
reviews.text:
The Paradisus Cancún Resort is simply enchanting!
Pleasant and beautifully scented surroundings.
We loved the food, and especially the service from the Malva restaurant team. Ivonn, Alberto, and Francisco always treated us wonderfully well; they were very kind and polite every day!
I wish them continued success!!!

reviews.author: Gustavo g
reviews.text: Having a wonderful time at Paradisus Hotel. Everyone was lovely, and the service in the rooms and restaurants was excellent, especially at BlueAgave, where Atilano and Teresa were outstanding. Thank you all so much for making our vacation extra special.

reviews.author: Jonathan Rodea Buensuceso
reviews.text:
Malva Restaurant was excellent, especially the staff. Ivonn was always attentive, as were Alberto and Francisco. Guillermo at the entrance was always very welcoming. It was a pleasure to be treated like family!

Overall, we loved everything!

Sincerely, Jonathan Rodea

reviews.author: Lucas Sarandon
reviews.text: Excellent service and great vibes….thanks Gladys and Nino from the ginger bar

reviews.author: Ana Paula Ruiz Velasco
reviews.text: Excellent vacation, service and food, very good service especially at the Blueagave restaurant with Captain Tere and waiter Atilano 😉

reviews.author: Livi Hernandez
reviews.text: Had an AMAZING vacation with the family! This was our first time staying at an all inclusive resort and this is the only way we will vacation from now on. The staff here is so friendly and accommodating. Spa experience was outstanding, beach is unbelievable, rooms are spacious. Galdino and Emmanuel went above and beyond for our family. There were 11 of us and Galdino helped make all our dinner reservations and Bali beds so every day we just relaxed and enjoyed our stay. Danny Flow and Say made sure we had so much fun dancing and activities. If you are traveling without kids, definitely stay in the Reserve. You won’t regret it!

reviews.author: Adam Shelton
reviews.text: Abraham & Katrina taught us in two separate classes, mezcal tastings and mixology classes, and they were my favorite part of the whole trip. They’re great at their jobs but even more fun as people!

reviews.author: Tom and Lori Bruggemann

Wonderful vacation! We had exceptional service from Carlos Quintero at the swim up pool bar. He was very friendly and made the best drinks!! We hope he is still there next time we go back.

Food was delicious with great service.

reviews.author: Lexi Shelton

reviews.text: love the service from Isidro, Hayme, and Wilbert at Agua Marina !! thank you again!

reviews.author: Eddie Baisden
reviews.text: We stayed at the paradisus cancun and this was our favorite restaurant. I had rhe octopus as an appetizer...incredible sauce...the rock seafood soup...tomatoey goodness and the squid which had a creme fraische that made it light and good. The sea bass was perfectly cooked with crispy skin and amazing seasoning to go with the mushroom risotto. Everything was fantastico. The service from Wilbur was perfect with great help from Isidro and Jaime. Thank you!

reviews.author: Merlin Lukose
reviews.text: Wilbur, Jimmy and Desilva at the Agua Marina restaurant were absolutely gems and catered to all the needs. Friendly staff and great food options overlooking the sea.

reviews.author: Alex Otero Ordoñez

reviews.author: JAS M
reviews.text:
My stay at the Paradisus Cancun began on April 26th, accompanied by three friends in two rooms for two nights. Unfortunately, the experience fell short of expectations for a hotel of this category.

From the moment of check-in, the service left much to be desired: there were nearly 20 people waiting to be attended to and only two receptionists available. The process took more than 30 minutes, and the staff's treatment was unfriendly, even disrespectful at times. A terrible first impression.

The hotel's design has its merits, especially in its central area, which is visually appealing. However, the rest of the complex is far from luxurious and shows clear signs of neglect in various areas.

One of the weakest points was the food. The buffet not only offered little variety, but the hot dishes were cold, and what should have been kept cold arrived lukewarm. Furthermore, the absence of seafood such as prawns was disappointing. The service from the restaurant staff was also poor.

As for the pools, although they were in good condition, finding a free lounge chair after 11 a.m. was virtually impossible, which negatively impacted the overall experience.

In short, I would not recommend this hotel nor would I consider returning. There are many areas for improvement, especially in guest service, food quality, and general maintenance of the property.

reviews.author: Gleyner James
reviews.text:
We recently stayed at Paradisus Cancún as a couple, and overall, it was a fantastic experience. The design and inner structure of the hotel are truly impressive — photos simply cannot capture how majestic the property feels in person. While some areas do feel a bit outdated, we were glad to hear that the company is planning a full refurbishment to make it the best hotel in Cancún. It certainly has the potential.

We stayed in The Reserve area, which we found especially pleasant. Compared to the Reserve section at Paradisus Playa del Carmen, this one is much more peaceful while still offering all the premium services. One thing we appreciated at Paradisus Cancún was the option to decline the concierge WhatsApp service. When we stayed in Playa del Carmen, the concierge service was overly intrusive and felt more focused on pushing for tips rather than genuinely helping us. We were bombarded with unsolicited WhatsApp messages, which honestly took away from the joy of exploring the hotel on our own. At Paradisus Cancún, we politely declined this service, and we felt it gave us back the freedom and excitement of discovery that makes travelling so special.

The highlight of our stay was, without a doubt, dinner at Flora Restaurant. The food was incredibly tasty and beautifully presented — a true gastronomic experience. A special mention goes to Anabel, who was professional, charming, and knowledgeable. She provided excellent recommendations that truly elevated our evening and made our dining experience unforgettable.

We loved every moment of our time at Paradisus Cancún and are already looking forward to returning after the refurbishment. With the planned updates, we’re sure it will become one of the top hotels in the region. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: lorena lodeiro
reviews.text:
Good evening, I'm staying at the hotel right now, today is my first day.
I agree with Sebastián's opinion (below). I don't understand why an "all-inclusive" hotel doesn't offer "everything included." What do I mean by that? I've stayed at other hotel chains where I didn't have to pay extra for meat. I can't believe that I have to pay extra to go to two of their restaurants. I've never experienced this before. The same goes for the wines; only two are included, and they aren't the best.
The signage isn't good; finding the Flora restaurant was difficult. However, I can't say anything negative about the service; Cinthia and Fanny were excellent, and the food was exquisite. We booked the highest Meliá category, Paradisus, so I didn't expect these things to be excluded. The same goes for the sun loungers (I don't remember what they're called here); they cost extra, unlike the regular lounge chairs, which are included. It's a real shame, I didn't expect it to be like this.
The room we got was perfect, comfortable, and cool (thankfully). The Flora restaurant is hot. All areas close at 11 pm; if you want something to eat or drink after that time, it's room service. And depending on your room category, they might deliver two or three times.
The only thing open 24 hours is the coffee area, where they serve something sweet or a savory sandwich.

reviews.text:
The room we stayed in was average with poor air conditioning.
This property needs to look up the meaning of the word "hospitality".
The concierge and guest services teams are slow, clueless, unhelpful and incompetent. The staff in general are indifferent and straight up rude on occasions.
They call themselves "all inclusive" but constantly try to get you to spend your hard earned $$$ at every conceivable opportunity. For example there are restaurants in the hotel that you need to pay extra for??? Oh and you need to make reservations for the majority of the restaurants. The food is below average as well. Pool beds and cabanas are up for rental even though there aren't enough "free" ones to accommodate all guests.
Seriously? If you're going to up-charge your guests at every opportunity at least have the decency to make it abundantly clear that your property isn't exactly all inclusive.
The property is sleepy at night and the entertainment is forgettable.
Spend a little more money to stay at a brand name resort like Hyatt because you actually get an all inclusive experience. It's a real shame because the beach itself is stunning.

The entire resort was magnificent. The concierge was very helpful and attentive, truly making my experience enjoyable and relaxing. The food was very good. I would love to return after the remodel; I was impressed! The pools were top-notch.
My girlfriend and I recently had a trip, and the experience was exceptional.
We were very impressed with the service; the staff, who were always friendly and helpful, elevated our experience to the next level.
There were nine restaurants to choose from and about five bars, all amazing, but I was most impressed by Aqua Marina. We've been three times, and the service has always been top-notch, with all the care and advice from Martin, the manager. For bars, we loved the Gingle Bar, with Salvador, Jorge, and Glady, all funny and making sure I was well looked after. Jose Garcia at the Capella restaurant helped us with incredible dinner choices. The food was excellent, and his
fun personality added to the experience.
Abraham at the Ginger Bar is always excellent. His mixology expertise allows us to try new and wonderful drinks on every visit.
I had a 75-minute full-body massage with Guadalupe! It was very well done and therefore very relaxing! The spa had a very zen feel with the water features just outside the spa area. I was satisfied with the experience overall. I wish I had been charged to my room instead of having to pay immediately on-site. At another Paradisus.

reviews.author: Kate Babusciac
reviews.text:
First of all, I want to mention that I’m not a picky vacationer. For me and my 3-year-old daughter, the most important things were the ability to relax on the beach and to have timely access to quality food. Unfortunately, our experience at this resort was extremely disappointing and stressful.

1. Beach Access:
Despite being at an all-inclusive resort, I was told I needed to pay $250 for a cabana because all the beach lounges were “reserved” — even though many were unoccupied. A staff member told me guests start claiming lounges as early as 4 a.m. I was not willing to wake up my toddler that early to compete for a place to relax. That same staff member then offered to reserve a spot for me — for cash — which felt inappropriate and unprofessional.

2. Dining Issues:
The buffet experience was chaotic and unsanitary. The food selection was poor, and the conditions were far from clean. We waited 40 minutes in line just to be seated — again, not ideal when trying to keep a young child fed on a schedule.

3. Dinner Reservations:
To have dinner at one of the restaurants, you had to reserve a table — which is a normal policy for all-inclusive resorts. However, I stood in line for one full hour trying to make a reservation, only to be told everything was fully booked for that evening. The only option offered was to pay out-of-pocket at a non-inclusive restaurant. Out of desperation, I went to the steakhouse to avoid another long buffet line and ended up spending $300.

4. Poor Customer Service & Disrespect:
The next day, I went to the front desk to express my concerns and to inform them that I would be leaving the resort. I was shocked at their response. They openly told me they didn’t care because the resort would be closing in a month for remodeling and rebranding. The staff was extremely rude — in front of my child — and made no effort to help or even apologize. Another family standing behind me also tried to cancel their stay and witnessed the entire exchange, including the disrespect and humiliation I experienced.

In the end, I had to book another hotel and leave, losing two days of my vacation — not to mention the emotional distress and migraine caused by this experience. I’ve never encountered such terrible treatment, especially as a single mother traveling with a child in a foreign country. I felt completely unprotected and unsupported.

reviews.text: Our experience at lemon fish at paradisus was incredible! Our server Miguel was attentive and funny and kept the drinks flowing and the food coming. reviews.author: Cin Pani
reviews.text:
We came to celebrate my sister in laws 40th Birthday at Paradisus Cancun " The Reserve" adult only side and we can't say enough great things about our stay.
From having our own concierge  Named Manuel who was incredible, from the moment we arrived, we were greeted with a warm and friendly welcome,  He was extremely attentive. He made all our Reservations for restaurant, boat cruise, greeted us with messages every morning and evening  with his schedule for the day. I requested a cake for my sister which he gladly accommodated us with. We had fruit and wine to welcome us and strawberries and champagne as a good bye. The room was spacious, clean, and beautiful, with stunning views of the ocean.
Stocked mini fridge every day with drinks, tray of snacks also daily filled. 24 hour room service.
The buffet food was excellent , they had something for everyone and they had many varieties. We loved the lemon fish restaurant it's fusion and Peruvian food was worth the hype. You must make reservations because it books quickly. The drinks throughout the resort were great and so was the service at the pool.  everyone so friendly and attentive. The beach was so clean and clear. You can expect the same service there. Drinks and food can be ordered no need to rush you always find beach chairs to lounge.
The resort's amenities were fantastic, when you book the reserve side it comes with a sunset Cruise and hydrotherapy spa which did wonders for us. We had the sauna, vapor room, cold plunge, it was magical.
We would highly recommend The Reserve Paradisus Cancun to anyone looking for a relaxing and memorable vacation!

reviews.text: Booked a ocean view reserve suite and didn’t get it. Room service sucks. Water from shower completely flooded the bathroom due to poor construction. AC can’t keep the room cold. Management doesn’t care. Not worth it.

I especially want to highlight the service from our waiter Jorge at Lemon Fish, who suggested delicious dishes, and from the buffet, Mr. Bernardo, who was very attentive and professional. We have a few more days, but so far everything has been perfect. The rooms are very spacious and comfortable. They need a few touch-ups, but we were told that a nice renovation is coming soon. reviews.author: Ronya Buzbee
reviews.text: The room was small, but clean.  Some flying bugs but I imagine the environment makes it hard to control those.  Staff was very friendly and location was in great proximity to airport.  Food was mediocre at best.  We tried all the restaurants and were not impressed at all by any of them.  The biggest issue though was with the pools. It was either 5-6ft depth or 2ft depth. This is difficult if you have a 7 year old who is not a strong swimmer but way too big for the 2ft baby pool. We always either had to be in the pool with her or had to watch her every second.  I would not recommend this resort to families with elementary aged children.  And I have a major issue with the cleanliness of the pools. Four days into our trip my daughter got hand foot mouth disease.  I am 100% sure she got it from the pool.  Main pool with the swim up bar specifically.  Always noticed things floating on top but assumed it was safe and treated with the necessary chemicals.  Not the case. You need to check your chlorine levels and sanitize.  Super grossed out by this.

reviews.author: lizett hernandez
reviews.text: The worst experience I've had with any of the hotels in this chain. Out of the five days we paid for all-inclusive, the minibar was only restocked twice, with the explanation that the staff weren't aware we'd paid for all-inclusive for those rooms. We reserved a Balinese cocktail, and the next day they wanted to change it simply because another family had requested it. At the Agua Marina restaurant, they told us they were out of the dessert we'd chosen, even though it was still early. They wouldn't let me use the kids' club with my baby due to "security concerns," which seemed illogical when it was clear the staff couldn't control and supervise all the children. At the Meliá Cozumel, I was able to use the space without any problem. On the beach, two foreign women blocked us off with two lounge chairs so we wouldn't invade "their space," which made us very uncomfortable and I found it incredibly disrespectful. Overall, the service left much to be desired, and although our concierge (we were with a Meliá Club card) was attentive to these details, little was done to resolve them. The only thing they offered was a late check-out and to sort out the issue with the luggage. The only positives were that some of the staff were very friendly and the facilities were in good condition, but I wouldn't return.

reviews.text:
This was our first time visiting this hotel, and here are my thoughts:

1. Location: Excellent and quite close to the airport.
2. Check-in: Super fast, and they let you use the facilities from the moment you arrive.
3. Food: Good, there's a great variety, but the best part is the snack bar: pizzas, wings, and fries are delicious.
4. Waiter service: Everyone was very friendly, but Didier in the pool area was the absolute best: excellent service, always super friendly, fast, attentive, and always with a great attitude. He treated us wonderfully.

Something that could be improved would be the rooms, as they're a bit dated and don't live up to the rest of the resort.

But I think I would definitely return.

reviews.text:
The hotel is very nice, the food is good, there's seafood, and the breakfast buffet was all very fresh. Didier served us at the pools, and he truly provided excellent service. He was attentive at all times. He brought us a variety of delicious snacks quickly, and he had a very pleasant conversation. If you come, ask for him; he'll treat you like royalty.

We'll definitely return, and if it's as good as the reviews say, it'll be even better. It was a pleasant surprise.

Best regards.

reviews.author: HSV
reviews.text:
took the advice of previous visitors and upgraded to the Adult Only Reserve. Since it was only my wife and I on this trip, not having to hear screaming children or watch out for running little ones, was great. Everyone on the staff that we interacted with were fantastic: our concierge Enrique, the cabana concierges David and Victor, our waiters Josue, Miguel, our spa staff Kristel, Keyli, Martin, the entertainment team were off the hook - Say and Daniel were not stop fun. We tried several of the resturants at the resort and most were pretty good. We really enjoyed Sals.

We are sad that they will be closed for a year long massive renovation starting next month, but are looking forward to coming back when they reopen.

reviews.author: Tomer Carmiel
reviews.text:
I am here for not even a day , I come to the pool to reserve pool chairs at 6:45am. The guard comes over and tells me I can’t do that till 7am. Ok 7:01 now and “Arny” the cabana boy tells me while I’m setting up that if I am gone for more than 45 min they will remove all of our things.
Isn’t the point of vacation is to relax , that is not one of the feelings I am experiencing right now.
We spent almost 3 couple 5k per couple. So almost 20k with kids and this is what you have to deal with over pool chairs.
If you are going to pack a hotel like livestock have the grounds accommodate or do not be Soo greedy and take our money and not provide the quality service you advertise

reviews.text: We love coming to Paradisus. Upon arriving at the hotel, Andree at reception was incredibly quick and friendly. The best part was Malva, the buffet; it's become my favorite restaurant. We celebrated my grandmother's birthday there, and he surprised us with the thoughtful decorations. Thank you so much for those details. Sergio, our waiter, was incredibly attentive to our needs and always on top of things. Thank you for making our stay so wonderful. I 100% recommend coming here.

reviews.author: saul cruz
reviews.text: Jesus was great from the capella restaurant

reviews.author: Cameryn Porter Choate
reviews.text:
We stayed 5 nights here last week. The experience was very hit and miss. We did two days at the pool on the adults only (reserve) side of the resort in reserved Bali beds. The first day we had excellent service and were very happy! The gal waiting on us checked on us frequently. The second day we spent in the reserved Bali bed we were checked on very little, had to retrieve drinks from the bar as waiter wasn't coming around frequently, ordered lunch through the app for the same reason, and at one point the staff had congregated directly by our bed and were chatting for several minutes which was a bit awkward. During that same day a staff member was literally painting the base of the Bali bed as we were laying in it... not very comfortable!

The buffet food was just okay. Some things better than others... some staff friendlier than others as well. The restaurant experience was much better with the exception of our dinner at Cielo which was not the best. Food wasn't great and service was very slow and Cielo. Sante was fantastic for both breakfast and dinner and Sal was great as well! Cappella was great service too!

Communication wasn't great. We were told our concierge would reach out quickly after checking in to assist us with reservations. We didn't hear from him until about 2pm on our second day and many of the restaurants book out days in advance so our reservation options were limited to what was available. When we didn't hear from the concierge in a timely fashion we were able to find a reservation table with staff members to assist us.

Rooms were okay! Not super noteworthy but worked for us. Shower and tub are nice. Walls are super thin, we heard a lot from our neighbors. We did find out from one of the staff members that the hotel is closing down in May and will be closed for a year as they complete major renovations. This makes sense considering a lot of the resort was in need of some attention. The resort is beautiful and photographs nicely but could definitely benefit from some renovations. It rained one day and the inside of the resort had  towels placed everywhere I assume because of leaks in the building.

Jesus from Cappella was amazing! He recommended the tagliata di manzo al rosmarino to my husband and it was delicious! 10/10 service and great food, beverage, and atmosphere! Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Kelley
reviews.text:
Gracias Charli, Gladys,and Irina
Service was fast friendly and WE appreciate you.

Special shoutout to Enrique our concierge who provided us with daily updates, reservations at restaurants organized us to experience the sunset Catarmaran and made John’s birthday extra memorable with special treats in our room.

Alexandro at Lemon Fish was exceptional sharing knowledge and experience with local tequilas.

Alexandro at the espresso bar gave us a warm smile and welcoming feel every morning when grabbing our cappuccino and Americanos.

The staff at the reserve pool surprised us with a birthday song and cake for my man. Well done!

Also awesome: the food, cleanliness everywhere, all staff, beautiful areas, and the beach.
We hope to visit again after the renovations.
Johnny and Kelley

reviews.text:
Um wow!  Where do I start?  This is my second time at Paradissus with my sweet pea and I am so glad I came back.

This is the last night and this evening sweet pea and I were blessed to have our last meal at Lemon Fish where we were lucky to be served by Jorge!  Jorge is a 10/10 and a true professional.  On top of all that he is such a hard worker and want to make the experience the very best for the guest.  Mission accomplished pal.  Thank you!

Frankly I had the same experience at every restaurant.  Auga Marina was terrific.  Huge thks to my guy Senior Martin, Carlos and Roberto.

One of the best parts of the vacay was seeing Pascal from the main buffet (I think malva).  We first met Pascal 7 years ago and we laughed because we still have breakfast.  Huge tip here: ask for Pascal because that fella is the very best.  Pascal, you are a true professional and represent the company well.  Bottom line is you make people want to return!

Lastly, I want to say, that if any readers are considering the Reserve option...DO IT! Oh boy was it the best.  The service and dedication from the pool staff is remarkable.  Frankly, my wife and I were floored by the concierge, Rossana, our Reserve concierge.  Everyday, she message us and helped everyday be the 💯 best that it could be.  To all readers and bosses of this resort, this lady made every effort possible to make our stay memorable.  Ask for Rossana, you will be happy you did!

Ok, this is a lot.  Thks paradissus and see you after the renovations!

reviews.author: mahtab ghafoorian
reviews.text:
I recently stayed at paradisus Cancún and overall had a nice time, but I was very disappointed with how a check-out situation was handled, especially considering the level of service I expected.

My flight was early, so we checked out at 6:15 AM, well before the official 12:30 PM check-out time. Breakfast was supposed to be served at 6:30 AM, and I kindly asked if we could enter the buffet 10 minutes earlier, just to grab something quickly before heading to the airport. The staff member (Henry) refused, which I understand might be policy — but what upset me was the dismissive attitude and the lack of willingness to even hear our situation.

Worse, after we checked out and our bracelets were cut (which the front desk said was fine), we kept our bracelets in our pocket, as we were still within our valid check-out time. Henry said we couldn’t access the breakfast buffet without a bracelet and would have to pay extra — even though we were still entitled to full service. When I explained this, he refused to speak respectfully or offer any help. I ended up going to reception to report the incident and ask for the manager’s contact.

The 24-hour Nespresso bar is a nice touch, but the pastries weren’t great, which is why I wanted a proper breakfast. I truly expected better customer service — especially in how staff communicate with guests in a rush or under stress.

It’s really a shame because, before this situation, I was very pleased with the resort and had a great experience overall. Unfortunately, the poor interaction with staff (Henry) has made me reconsider recommending this resort or returning again.

My best food recommendation is while vacationing in Mexico, eat the Mexican food and you will not be disappointed! We didn’t love the Italian restaurant but we also live in CT where we have the best Italian food outside of Italy.

We stayed in Mexico for 9 days and 5 of those were spent at Paradisus. We upgraded to the adults only side. One of the many perks of the adults only reservation is that you receive 2 days in the Bali beds! I highly recommend using this perk. We received nonstop service with food and drinks.

Also included with our stay was a sunset cruise. The music on the boat and energy of the staff was infectious!

All in all we’re sad to be leaving because we had the best time EVER! 5 stars!!!!!

reviews.text:
I have visited this resort before too. But the experience was not so good this time around. We stayed for 4 days in the family section. Our room had to be changed first because the door to the bathroom was missing. The second room was even worse. The shower handle did not work, the plants in the balcony were all dried up coz no one had been watering.. The worst part was the roach infestation. The fridge was infested with roaches. You could easily see that roaches had been vacationing there for a while as the corner of the fridge cabinet was all blackened with roach feces.
They were crawling on the floor, in the bathroom and would come out sprinting when you opened the fridge. I made written and verbal complaints for 3 days... but nothing was done to fix the issue. I have multiple photos and videos.

Food was decent and beaches are beautiful.
No more paradisus for me.

reviews.author: Phil Gibson
reviews.text:
Hydrotherapy was incredible.  Felt good and Martin was helpful and provided insight for each step.
UPDATE: I wanted to provide an update on our stay at Paradisus Cancun.  As referenced above the spa experience was great, staff and massage therapist were excellent.  Ran into an issue with my locker and they resolved without incident.  Our room looked out over the ocean and pool area, which was great.  Service to rooms was excellent and rooms were clean and well kept.  The remaining staff at this location are very good and always friendly.
Now for the cons - This hotel is going to be closing in May for renovations, which are evident and needed.  We knew that going in, but decided to stay here anyway.   First issue, when booking if not booking through the hotel itself you are not guaranteed your room type(king/queen bed(s)) so my wife and I ended up with 2 double beds.  Not the end of the world, but not expected either because we were told we had a king at checkin.   Check in staff was less than helpful to resolve that situation, so started off vacation a bit irritated.  Secondly, due to short staffing the restaurant reservation system is a joke.  They act like they have all this availability, but allow people to book reservations for their entire stay and some people we heard were booking multiple reservations on the same day for different restaurants so they could decide what they wanted last minute.  All restaurants appeared to be half empty and in most cases you weren't able to walk up and possibly take a table that no one was using.  Half way through the stay, the staff finally admitted they were short staffed.  If you were willing to pay additional amount you could get a table...found that out later.  This system needs a full revamp.  We have stayed at other resorts in Cancun and the restaurant situation was much more suitable based on size of resort.  This hotel due to their upcoming closure just didn't have the staff to manage a full hotel of guests inside their restaurants.   Blue Agave, great tacos and staff was excellent.  Buffet food quality was average, selection very good.  Lemon Fish, average food, service good.  Sate, food good, service good, 3/4 empty when they said they were full.  We only were able to get a reservation here because we showed interest in a new program they were offering.   Reservation got screwed up a Flora, but manager was able to squeeze us in at last minute around 9pm, food below average and cold, service ok.  Didn't try the other restaurants due to reservation or availability challenges.

My guess is after renovations this will be a good place to try if they make appropriate changes to restaurants, staff increases and quality.  Just needs a refresh.   Be aware of possible room changes if you didn't book with hotel.  Overall a 3, but might be worth a try after reno.

reviews.text:
We stayed 3 nights at this all inclusive resort.
Things I liked about this resort....
1. Not located in hotel zona but away from the tourist
2. Sunset cruise and Mexican show
3. Guacamole, Salsa, Salsa dancing classes
4. Sayani, Nestor, Junior were fun and entertaining
5. Patricia is calm and very focussed, Emmanuel was friendly
and accomodating
6. Blue Agave tacos are great for vegetarians
7. Flora restaturant has vegetarian menu, include more options
8. Loved the concept of bracelet key into the rooms
Things which I did not like about...
1. The vegetarian options were good but lacked quality at Malva
2. More continental vegetarian food options would be better
3. Our conceirge guy "Daniel" was not actively persuing our reservations. He was not motivated to impress us.
4. Bathroom and Balcony doors were heavy, need an upgrade
5. Not easy to reserve restaurants, bali bed. Don't overbook and disappoint you other guests
6. The snack bar has just coffee and desserts, pls have tacos and salsa available through out.
7. Malva is nice concept but have different continental food. The oatmeal that was served was horrible.

reviews.author: sahana emerge
reviews.text: This was our first time in an all inclusive resort. The booking was easy and we opted for a family concierge for a extra price. A week before we landed we got an option to book our sun set cruise. The restaurant reservations booking would happen only after we check-in. We checked into the resort early and hotel room was available only at 3pm that day. However our luggage was held in a near by storage area. The resort is fully covered with pothos hanging all over. The reception staff is courteous but felt they lacked communication skills. We had a guy assigned as part of family concierge by name Daniel. He pinged us after 4pm to ask us what restaurant reservations we wanted. Most of the restaurants weren't available so that really pissed us off. He never made an attempt to get this issue sorted. As part of all inclusive we were promised of certain things and most of them were booked. I had to complain about this guy to his superiors. Getting Bali Bed for one day near pool was more challenging. His superior Emmanuel was friendly and got us one bed finally. The food was pretty basic for vegetarians. "Flora" was good but rest were just below average food. The tacos were good. I wish there were more continental options like Thai, Indian, Mede terrain and Chinese. What I loved was the classes that happened near "The Reserve". Although meant for customers who booked "The Reserve", the staff encouraged anyone interested in doing such activities. I attended "Guacamole", "Salsa" n "Salsa Dance" making classes with Sayani was amazing. Margarita making was fun with Nestor. Ceramic Painting and making dream catchers was entertaining. The silent party one night was unique with headphones on the beach. I wish the beach was more accessible. The beach was filled with sea weeds and so close to the benches. The rooms are dated, bathroom doors and balcony doors needed a heavy muscle to move. We opted for a ocean facing room. The mini bar was stacked each day with beer, drinks, snacks. They sent me a bottle of wine and cake as we were celebrating my birthday. The sunset cruise was awesome with a saxophone artist playing live through out 2 hour cruise. The cruise staff offered us cocktails n juices. The vegetarian sandwich was yummy. The Sauna, Steam and Jacuzzi was rejuvenating.  The resort arranged for a Mexican show one night with Mexican food and dances from different parts. I really felt resort tried its best to please the residents. I felt they overbooked so the restaurants and few of these unique activities was hard to get appointments. They will be closed for a year for major renovations.

reviews.author: Aaron P
reviews.text:
Resort location - 4 stars.  Beautiful views of the ocean.
Rooms - 3 stars.  Would be great if they offered two queen size beds versus doubles.  Would be nice if the planters weren't there on the balconies so you could have a better direct view of the ocean.  My wife and I had to sleep in separate beds.  I specially asked the front desk receptionist for a king size bed (I made a note of that online when booking too).  It seemed like she didn't listen, I noticed she was on the phone in a text chat while checking us in.  We had planned to share a king size bed and have my wife's mother sleep on the couch / pull out bed (we booked 3 people in our room).
Service - 2 stars,  this is directly a rating of the wait staff at most of the restaurants.  The wait staff seemed to have a "tolerate the guest" attitude and didn't have a genuine friendly attitude.  One example - the hostess that worked at Cielo restaurant would give dirty looks and wasn't friendly and you could tell she didn't like the guests.  Most wait staff had a chip on their shoulders and were annoyed with guests (tolorate the guest attitude). They tried to hide that fact but their true feelings showed through in facial expressions and actions.  I highly recommend any guest staying here to visit Fred's Seafood that is located across the street from the Marriott. It's a short 5-10 minute walk down the street. The food,  ambiance and service their is top tier.  Compare their service and overall quality (food + wait staff) with Paradisus and you'll see exactly what I mean.

Overall my family and I had a good experience at the resort. If we decide to return to cancun we will certainly give another resort (all inclusive or not all inclusive) a try.

I included a photo of the beach and my view from an ocean facing balcony room.

reviews.author: Jerusalem Spider
reviews.text: Expect to be treated terribly if you're not a foreigner. The bartenders at the main pool are very rude and unfriendly, as are almost all the people in the restaurants. We went on a business trip with about 100 people from the company I work for, and everyone was complaining about the poor treatment and service. Some colleagues had their doors opened by the cleaning staff and were seen without clothes. One colleague's room flooded, two others had power outages, and two more had no hot water. At reception, when we were given our rooms, the Americans were given a full explanation of the hotel map and services, but we were only given a brochure and told that all the information was there. We were denied tables, but if foreigners asked, they were seated immediately. The food was awful! Bland, tasteless, and always with very little variety. Only three waiters were extremely kind and attentive; all the other staff we interacted with were rude and dismissive. A terrible service experience. Don't even bother replying if you're just going to give a generic response with no intention of making any changes. As the head of a UX department, I'd rather you not respond at all than give the same answer you give everyone, which only demonstrates your lack of empathy and intention to make a difference. After years of negative reviews and with many of us still complaining about the same things, it's clear you haven't done anything to demand friendlier and more helpful customer service.

The hotel facilities were good also.  We had a small leak from condensation and locked ourselves outside of the safe deposit and requested the hot tub to be cleaned and the response was expedient.

The star of this whole trip was Atzi. She delivered above five stars on everything we needed.  I recommend she get promoted! One of the first impressions I have of her is her professionalism and fairness. She met with me in the lobby and noticed someone jumped the line and she acknowledged me first and then the second person.

Lastly, the Yhi Spa is a must. Atzi suggested the hydrotherapy before hand it it elevated the spa experience from 8 to a 12.

reviews.author: César
reviews.text: "I DO NOT RECOMMEND THAT HOTEL." I stayed from March 28th to 31st, 2025, and my reservation, paid a month in advance, was for a Junior Suite with an OCEAN VIEW. Upon arrival, I was assigned a room on the ground floor with a view of a nearly two-meter-tall planter, with a patio (it can't really be called a balcony) with exposed plumbing and no chairs or table. When I complained to the staff, they told me that the hotel has that floor and those rooms listed as having an ocean view, that the planters are for hurricane protection, and that they were currently fully booked. They said they could move me to another floor the following day, provided there was availability. When I requested a full refund of my reservation or a proportional refund for the room, they refused, arguing that since it was booked through an agency, I had to complain to them. The facilities are very nice, as are the beach and pools; the bar staff and some waiters are not rude but not friendly either.

reviews.author: Parth Patel
reviews.text:
During our stay at Paradisus Cancun, we had the pleasure of dining at Cielo, and it was truly one of the highlights of our trip. The ambiance was beautiful, the food was flavorful and artfully presented, but what really elevated the experience was the exceptional service.

We were lucky to have Moises as our server, and he went above and beyond to make us feel welcome and cared for. His attentiveness, genuine kindness, and professionalism were unmatched. He took the time to explain the menu, made thoughtful recommendations, and checked in regularly to ensure everything was perfect. You can truly tell he takes pride in what he does, and it made our dining experience feel incredibly special.

The entire serving team was friendly and efficient, but Moises stood out as someone who made our night unforgettable. Thank you for the amazing service, delicious food, and warm hospitality. We can’t wait to return!

reviews.text:
My husband and I stayed here for 5 nights. We loved the hotel and location. The decor and atmosphere is beautiful. The view of the beach is breathtaking.

The service unfortunately is not up to par and this is what didn’t make it the best experience we were hoping for.

Alondra who checked us in at The Reserve was very matter of fact, rude, and unwelcoming.  She didn’t welcome us with a smile when we arrived and didn’t even ask about our experience when we checked out. It was very revealing of her character and lack of professionalism.

Some of the employees who work at the other restaurants and buffets can also be very disrespectful with their actions and lack of professionalism. There was an employee who worked in the kitchen at the Malva Buffet who ignored me and rolled her eyes when I kindly asked where the omelets were being served, and had a bad attitude when I asked to speak to the person in charge about her actions.

On a positive note, I do have to say Gerardo who works as a server at the Malva buffet is very kind-hearted and cares about making your experience memorable. He went out of his way to always make sure we were cared for. Fernando at Blue Agave also stood out from the rest with his heart of service. Ismael at the spa was also patient and kind with us.

There are some kind employees there~ but it’s honestly a hit or miss.

They need to be consistent with their service and I hope they take this review as an eye opener to coach their employees  about the seriousness and importance of quality customer service.

reviews.text:
The location is convenient especially with the aqua world directly across the road for some activities. The resort is beautiful in general especially the main lobby area. The service was usually pretty good with friendly wait staff across the resort. The food at most restaurants is average at best with little flavor. As many other posts noted you can probably stick to the buffet each day and have the same or better experience. The room was showing signs of its age. Fridge was broken and when they “fixed” it, while now cold it started making loud noises. I will say they acted promptly when it was brought to their attention. Most frustrating part of the stay as other also mention is the pool/beach seating situation. They allow other guests to place 4,5,6…etc towels on all the chairs in large sections at 6:30-7am. Those guests then sometimes don’t arrive to the pool/beach until 3-4 hours later since they “claimed” these seats. If you show up after 8am good luck finding a spot anywhere. And typically once they leave half the time they leave their towel instead of placing it in the bins so 80% of the chairs appear taken when someone left hours ago… pretty crazy situation every single day. Seems like a simple fix, but from other reviews they refuse to address it so it continues…
The service was spotty as well. On average someone would come by once a hour to ask for drink orders… sometimes more sometimes less. lovely resort and people but probably wouldn’t return due to the just ok food and the terrible pool/beach seating.

reviews.text: Resort is very nice.  However that’s where it ends.  Food is average at best.  The couple restaurants we could get in were good.  But every day you have to go to a desk at 10am and either full or a 930 or 10pm available at same couple restaurants you’ve been to.  So didn’t get to all of them.  Service around the pools is ok some of the time.  One day had cabanas and someone came first hour or so but then didn’t see a server for hours and had to get a round of drinks for the 10-12 of us each time.  Seems odd when you spend so much to rent these.  Then theres the upgrade that was rescinded because of a leak in the room we were going to move to for the family concierge package we had.  So then we had to backtrack on the evening cruise with the other 20 we traveled with.  Then there was the broken door in the  bathroom that had we stuck for 30 minutes plus while they called people in the crowbar the door open.  Which was just left busted up and broken for the last few days of our trip.  Overall it was quite the experience at the paradisus and we were able to cross it off the list for future reference.  No surprise they are closing soon for renovations.  We filled the last couple days with excursions and stayed off property during the day.  Overall not being able to get in restaurants and service overall was poor and we wouldn’t go back.  Lesson learned about Melia and how they handle things.  Just hadn’t seen service that poor at a highly rated resort.

reviews.text:
My boyfriend and I stayed here for a week and absolutely enjoyed every second. Amazing service by all staff the second we got dropped off at the resort.

We stayed in the upgraded adults only reserve area and I can promise it is worth the extra cost. Our concierge Lalo was super responsive, friendly, and promptly took care of anything we needed with one message. Lalo knew it was our anniversary on one of the days we were staying and went out of his way to find out when we would be at the spa so he could set up rose petals on the bed, a complimentary bottle of champagne, and a card wishing us a happy anniversary. He also went above and beyond to book us into a special 4 course beach front dinner with live music without us even having to ask and even responded to questions on his day off. Absolutely amazing service from Lalo!

The atmosphere is unlike anything I have ever experienced. The resort is gorgeous in ever single area and even smells great and clean. The staff are all incredibly friendly.

We got a hydrotherapy treatment included as part of the reserve upgrade and it was a great addition to our trip. The Bali beds are also a great perk of the reserve area. There is a private nespresso bar in the reserve area where we got coffee (with kaluha and Bailey’s) contanstly and has great food options especially at breakfast. This area was a great, relaxing, and beautiful spot to have breakfast and there was one specific employee working there often who offers excellent service. I didn’t catch his name but you will know him if you see him, he is always smiling and going out of his way to provide great service.

The food at every restaurant was incredible. Food is a major aspect of an enjoyable vacation for my boyfriend and he couldn’t have been happier. Even the buffets (which are often a concern at all inclusives) blew us out of the water every time.

I can not say enough good things about this resort. If you are debating which resort to stay at, choose paradisus and I guarantee you will not be disappointed.
